_doc: Harness-side analyst notes behind spec/inventory.json (build_inventory.py). contract_notes may name classes; they never go into spec/.

groups.core-model: Structures, forests, rows and items: the hierarchy model and its storage-facing managers
groups.generators: Automation that builds or reshapes a forest: inserters, extenders, groupers, sorters, filters
groups.attributes: Values shown in columns and used by formulas: loaders, aggregates, expressions
groups.effects: Write-back from structure changes or attribute values to Jira (effect providers, effectors)
groups.sync: Synchronizers keeping a structure and Jira data (links, sub-tasks, Agile, filters) in step
groups.query: Structured JQL (S-JQL), the structure() JQL function and query constraints
groups.views-columns: Saved views, column definitions, notes columns
groups.persistence: Database tables (Active Objects), properties, locks and stored settings
groups.history-events: Change tracking, issue events, structure history and activity streams
groups.permissions-security: Structure permissions, access checks and security filters
groups.jobs-processes: Background jobs and long-running user processes with progress
groups.export: Export and print renderers (Excel, printable view, JSON)
groups.integrations: Integrations with other apps (Agile, Advanced Roadmaps, Tempo, Assets/Insight, Service Management, ScriptRunner and others)
groups.ui-pages: Front-end resources and server-rendered pages: board, grid, dialogs, admin pages
groups.ui-navigation: Menus, web sections and items, web panels, keyboard shortcut
groups.admin-config: Global and per-project configuration and defaults
groups.licensing-support: Licensing, end-of-life notices, support tools, statistics
groups.platform: Jira-version adaptation, lifecycle, caching, cluster and utility services
groups.cfd: Cumulative flow diagram gadget and its back end
groups.extension-points: Module types and services the plugin offers to companion apps
groups.user-data: User key changes, anonymisation and ownership transfer (GDPR)

action-context-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter exposing the current web action's request and response in the common bridged form.

add-comment-effect-provider.purpose: Adds a comment with the given text to an issue as the current user (blank text is a no-op), validated by Jira's comment service. Its undo deletes the created comment; several effects for one issue keep the last one and record the others as conflicts.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:add-comment-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

adjustIssuePage.purpose: Attached to the Jira issue view; when Structure is enabled for issue pages it loads Jira/AUI dependencies and, through the conditional wrapper, the issue page script. Separate variants for Jira 9 and 10+.

adjustIssuePageCond.purpose: Conditional wrapper that pulls in the issue page script only when the current user may use Structure. Separate variants for Jira 9 and 10+.

adjustment-service.purpose: Manages manual adjustments to generated structures: whether they are enabled globally and per structure, who may make them, applying and deleting adjustments, and reporting usage statistics.

adjustment-store.purpose: Persists per-structure manual adjustments to an automated (generated) forest as a versioned serialized blob with optimistic concurrency and a per-structure size limit.

affects-versions-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes or sets an issue's Affects Version/s; versions must belong to the issue's project and archived versions cannot be added or removed except on undo. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:affects-versions-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue', 'add', 'remove', 'set' (lists of value keys; add/remove are mutually exclusive with set), 'conflicts', 'sendNotifications'

aggregate-function-provider.purpose: Serves two tree aggregations. 'aggregation-array' collects an inner attribute's values over a tree scope (sub-tree, ancestors, children, leaves and others). It can flatten, remove duplicates or empties, reverse, or limit to a level range. 'aggregation-join' joins the values into text with separators and brackets around children, writing '?' for missing values.
contract_notes: params: 'attribute', 'type' (tree scope, default 'subtree' for array and 'ancestors' for join), 'distinct', 'flatten', 'compact', 'reverse', 'withoutTitle', 'fromLevel'/'fromdepth', 'toLevel'/'todepth', 'separator' (default ', '), 'beforechildren' (default '('), 'afterchildren' (default ')')
fails with an array-size-limit error when the result exceeds the expression array limit

aggregate-order-provider.purpose: Serves the 'max' and 'min' aggregates: the largest or smallest value of an attribute over a row and its sub-tree. Text is compared ignoring case. When the requested format differs from the one compared, it picks the row by the compared value and returns that row's value in the requested format.
contract_notes: attribute ids 'max' and 'min'; param 'attribute' (dependency; format text, number, duration, time, order or any)

agile-board.purpose: Inserter "Agile Board": inserts issues from a Jira Software board's filter, either only epics or only non-epic, non-sub-task issues; available only when boards are supported.

agile-structure.purpose: Wizard template "Agile Structure": inserts epics from selected Agile boards, adds stories under epics and optionally sorts by rank, with options to allow epic and rank changes via Structure.

ao.purpose: Declares the plugin's Active Objects database schema (39 tables) holding all persistent Structure data: structures, forests and change log, rows, generators, item types, folders, generic items and their history, views, favorites, properties, history, sync instances/events/audit, effectors and effect records, orderings, manual adjustments, notes, saved columns and process state.
contract_notes: AO namespace com.almworks.jira.structure; physical table prefix AO_8BAD1B_ (e.g. AO_8BAD1B_ROW)

tables: BOOTSTRAP, ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_EVENTS_V2, NODE_SIGNS_V2, ROW, STRUCTURE, FOREST, FOREST_CHANGE, GENERATOR, VIEW, STRUCTURE_TO_VIEW, VIEW_TO_STRUCTURE, PROPERTY, FOLDER, FAVORITES, STATISTICS, HISTORY_ENTRY, HISTORY_CHANGE, HISTORY_ISSUE, HISTORY_PROJECT, PERSPECTIVE, ISSUE_INDEX, SYNC_INSTANCE, SYNC_EVENT, SYNC_AUDIT_RECORD, ORDERING, PROCESS_STATE, STRUCTURE_PROPERTY, S_ITEM_PROPERTY, GENERIC_ITEM, ATOMIC_FLAG, MANUAL_ADJUSTMENTS, EFFECTOR_INSTANCE, EFFECTOR_PROCESS, EFFECTOR_RECORD, MIGRATION_CONFIG, SAVED_COLUMN, NOTE, GENERIC_ITEM_HISTORY

ao-based-statistics-service.purpose: Persists usage statistics samples (timestamp, user key, statistic name, value) in the database, answers unique-user counts per statistic over a time range, builds a report from samples since a timestamp, deletes old samples, and participates in user anonymization and user-key rename by counting and rewriting a user's records.
contract_notes: AO table STATISTICS with columns C_TIMESTAMP, C_USERKEY, C_STAT, C_VALUE

ao-based-view-manager.purpose: Stores views (named column/layout specifications with owner, permissions and sharing) and per-structure view settings (which views are offered and default per page: board, issue page, project tab, gadget) plus global defaults; enforces view creation and sharing rights, builds view menus, and reports pinned-column statistics.

ao-helper.purpose: Shared database access layer over Active Objects for all plugin tables: find, count, create (also with explicit id), delete, raw SQL with table/column substitution, sorted/limited queries and a small where-clause builder, respecting the database lock state and a 999-parameter batch limit.
contract_notes: primary key column ID on all plugin AO tables

ao-initializer.purpose: At startup verifies that Structure's Active Objects tables are usable; if initialisation fails it shuts the Structure plugin down with a prominent log message unless an override flag is set.

ao-lock.purpose: Plugin-wide database lock used while the whole Structure database is replaced or migrated (for example restore): sets a 'locked' flag in the BOOTSTRAP table that every cluster node sees, so other database work is refused until it is unlocked by the locking thread or by a forced unlock; waits up to a configurable timeout (60 s default).

app-support-client.purpose: Periodically (daily by default) reports license and installation facts for Structure and its registered extension apps to the vendor's app-support service, and records whether the vendor says each license is blocked; skipped in dev mode unless enabled. Out of scope for the replacement (INVENTORY.md section 5): it never contacts the vendor; keep the module key, send nothing.

app-support-connector.purpose: HTTP client to the vendor's app-support web service: posts JSON requests encrypted with an embedded RSA public key and decrypts responses, with configurable base URL and timeout. Out of scope for the replacement (INVENTORY.md section 5): it makes no network calls; keep the module key only.

app-support-store.purpose: Stores and answers which license serial numbers the vendor's app-support check has marked as blocked; other modules and extension apps query it to restrict licensed functionality.

assignee-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Assignee to a given user (or unassigns when empty). Skips the change when the user already matches; validates through Jira's normal issue update (permissions, field on screen), optionally without notifications, and records an undo effect restoring the previous assignee.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:assignee-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

attachment-config-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter that reports whether attachments are enabled in Jira.

attribute-aware-process-registry.purpose: Coordinates attribute-loading processes with cache clearing: running loads are cancelled when caches are cleared or the plugin stops, and new loads wait until a clear completes.

attribute-detailed-log-provider.purpose: Builds a diagnostic dump of the attribute subsystem (historical timing statistics, broken attributes, cache size by attribute) shown on the admin attribute troubleshooting page.
contract_notes: used by admin action StructureAttributeTroubleshooting (template admin/attribute-troubleshooting.vm)

attribute-loader-cache.purpose: Bounded, slowly expiring cache that remembers the resolved loader for each attribute specification so repeated attribute requests skip loader resolution.

attribute-performance-tracker.purpose: Collects attribute-loading performance metrics, keeps a ring buffer of slow requests and a record of attributes that failed to load (with last user, forest, row, item), and periodically snapshots statistics.

attribute-sensitivity-manager.purpose: Decides which attributes are treated as sensitive (may leak data from items the user cannot see) according to the admin's security setting: standard, strict or permissive, plus an admin whitelist of non-sensitive attributes.

attribute-sensitivity-rc.purpose: Page script and styles for the attribute sensitivity admin page (load, validate and save settings).

attribute-service.purpose: Public attribute service: loads values of attributes (fields, formulas, aggregates, progress, etc.) for rows of a forest or for items, in bulk, with consistency checks against forest changes, update checking and per-user security; used by the grid, REST, export and gadgets.

attribute-service-performance-log-provid.purpose: Adds an 'Attribute System' section to the performance audit log: the last attribute cache cleanup and recent slow attribute-loading requests, each with total time, start time, counters and nested requests.

attribute-service-support.purpose: Owns the shared attribute value cache and its change observer and loading protector, wiring them to the row manager, item tracker and forest service so attribute values are invalidated when items or forests change.

attribute-subscription-service.purpose: Public service for creating, retrieving and dropping attribute subscriptions, which keep a set of attribute values for a forest loaded in the background and report incremental value changes to clients; idle subscriptions expire.

attribute-troubleshooting-rc.purpose: Dependency bundle (no own files) for the attribute troubleshooting admin page: expander, date picker and Structure page utilities.

backlog-structure.purpose: Wizard template "Backlog Structure": inserts issues of selected projects and versions with a JQL inserter and groups them by a chosen field, epic or sprint, optionally allowing changes via Structure.

backup-manager.purpose: Public service that creates backup, restore (current backup format), migrate and migrate-preview operations for Structure data.

basic-generation-info-provider.purpose: For rows created by a generator, serves a small JSON object. It holds the creating generator's kind (sub-structure inserter, extender, grouper or inserter) and the generator's label, if any. Never cached.
contract_notes: attribute id: basic-generation-info (json object) with keys creator (ssi|extender|grouper|inserter) and label

bulk-change-interceptor.purpose: Supports Jira bulk change started from Structure. On /secure/Bulk* pages, if the session holds a Structure-created bulk-edit selection, it substitutes that selection's search into the session, redirects the final return to the issue navigator back to the originating Structure page, and keeps Structure's selected issues when Jira replaces the bulk-edit state.
contract_notes: Jira session attributes used: jira.bulkeditbean, jira.issue.navigator.search.request
Started by webwork alias StructureBulkChange (issue ids + home URL)

bulk-comment-reader.purpose: Reads, in batches directly from Jira's database, the most recent comment of each issue that the user is allowed to see, for the 'last comment' attribute.

bulk-link-processor.purpose: Creates and deletes many issue links in one transaction for a user, choosing either a direct entity-store implementation or Jira's link manager depending on a flag; used by link synchronizers and effectors.

bulk-permission-checker.purpose: Builds fast checks for whether a user belongs to a project role or a group for a batch of issues, used to filter restricted comments and worklogs in attributes.

bundled-column-source.purpose: Read-only built-in saved column list 'bundled' of ready formula columns: WSJF (Basic, Tempo, SAFe), Total Work Ratio (points/time), bug-fix percentage (time/count), Total Underestimation, Due In, Time to Resolve and Time Since Last Update, adapting to the story points field.
contract_notes: Saved-column source/list id 'bundled' with fixed numeric column ids; columns are type 'formula'

c3.purpose: Bundled charting libraries (d3 and c3) and their styles, used by the cumulative flow diagram gadget.

cascade-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a cascading-select custom field on an issue to a given option (parent option, or parent plus child), or clears it, via a validated issue update; undo restores the previous option.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:cascade-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
'value' is a custom-field option item id (item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-cf-option)

certificate-manager.purpose: Holds the vendor's X.509 certificate embedded in the plugin and verifies that other certificates are signed by it; used when validating signed license or support material.

cfd-completion-service.purpose: Loads the delivery scope and training history for the CFD feature, groups stories and epics by team, derives averages such as stories per epic, and drives the per-team completion simulator; also records a calculation trace for diagnostics.

cfd-distribution.purpose: Supplies the random integer distribution (geometric, parameterised by a mean) used by the CFD completion simulation to sample how many stories or how much throughput occurs per interval.

cfd-gadget.purpose: Jira dashboard gadget 'Cumulative Flow Diagram' that charts work items of a scope structure over time and forecasts completion using a training structure and simulation, with options for issue types, team attribute, target date, appearance/start/completion attributes and adjustments.
contract_notes: user prefs: scopeStructureId, trainingStructureId, trainingPeriod, estimationIssueTypes, scopeIssueTypes, teamAttributeSpec, targetDate, whenAppearedAttributeSpec, whenWorkStartedAttributeSpec, whenCompletedAttributeSpec, ignoreThreshold, adjustments, customTitle, isConfigured

cfd-gadget-bare.purpose: Cumulative flow diagram gadget code, chart and templates without dependencies.

cfd-gadget-resources.purpose: Complete resource set for the Cumulative Flow Diagram gadget.

cfd-issue-loader.purpose: Reads a structure's forest as an agile delivery hierarchy for the CFD feature: identifies epics and stories by configured issue types, and reads each story's key, team (default 'No Team'), status category (to do / in progress / done) and appearance, start and completion dates via attributes.

cfd-meta-maker.purpose: Validates the settings of the Cumulative Flow Diagram gadget (scope and training structures, training period, team and completion attributes, issue types, target date, ignore threshold) and returns per-field localized errors, the scope and training structures and the current user; also reports whether the predictive CFD feature is enabled.

cfd-simulator.purpose: Computes the predictive cumulative flow diagram: loads historical delivery from a training structure and remaining work from a scope structure, builds per-team throughput models and runs a Monte-Carlo style completion simulation, returning past and predicted flow series, per-team statistics and predicted completion dates; refuses when the feature is disabled.

change-history-provider.purpose: Serves 'history': the list of change-history group items for an issue. Histories are loaded in bulk for all requested issues and kept for formulas to read.
contract_notes: attribute id: history (format value); items are change-history-group identities

children-automations-hint-provider.purpose: Serves an HTML tooltip hint for rows that have user-added generators or effectors among their children. It lists each one with its icon and summary under localized generator and effector headings.
contract_notes: attribute id: children-automations-hint (html); internal aggregate format children-automations-aggregate
i18n keys s.ext.aut.hint.header, s.ext.aut.hint.gen.header, s.ext.aut.hint.eff.header, s.ext.gen.hint.no-summary

clipboard-manager.purpose: Keeps a per-session in-memory clipboard forest so users can copy or cut rows and paste them into structures; idle clipboards expire.

cloud-data-migrator.purpose: Listener for the Jira Cloud Migration Assistant (Connect and Forge paths). When a migration starts it finds the configuration matching the migration plan name (or migrates everything), backs up the selected structures, their views and Structure dashboard gadgets into zipped app-data chunks, uploads a table of contents and updates the configuration status.
contract_notes: Implements the Atlassian app-migration discoverable listener interfaces (Connect and Forge)
Server app key com.almworks.jira.structure; Forge app id default 94d5de1a-112d-4549-bd03-5f910d5fd27b
App-data labels structure_backup_<n> and structure_backup_table_of_contents; zip entry meta.json; TOC JSON with configs/selectedConfig and count/sequence

cluster-messaging-service-wrapper.purpose: Sends and receives Structure's inter-node messages over Jira's cluster messaging on Data Center; does nothing on a single server.

comments-item-provider.purpose: Serves 'comments': the list of comment items on an issue that the current user may see. Visibility is checked in bulk against comment role and group restrictions, and the comments are pre-loaded so formulas can read them.
contract_notes: attribute id: comments (format value); item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-comment; reads Jira table Action (id, issue, rolelevel, level)

components-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes or sets an issue's Components; each component must belong to the issue's project. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:components-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue', 'add', 'remove', 'set' (lists of value keys; add/remove are mutually exclusive with set), 'conflicts', 'sendNotifications'

confluence-auth-utils.purpose: Helper that opens a popup login window to an application-linked Confluence and warns when popups are blocked.

confluence-templates.purpose: Front-end templates for the error banner shown when Confluence-backed content in the widget cannot be loaded, with retry and action buttons.

constraint-folder.purpose: S-JQL constraint folder(): matches folder rows, optionally only those whose name matches a text or /regex/ argument.

constraint-item.purpose: S-JQL constraint item(type[, text]): matches rows whose item type matches the given type name (short or full, or * for any) and optionally whose summary matches a text query or /regex/.

constraint-memo.purpose: S-JQL constraint memo(): matches memo rows, optionally filtered by text or /regex/ on the memo text.

constraint-planningtask.purpose: S-JQL constraint planningtask(): matches planning task rows, optionally filtered by text or /regex/ on the summary.

constraint-rowId.purpose: S-JQL row id constraint (see contract notes for its name): takes one positive number and matches only the row with that row id.

conversion-effect-provider.purpose: Converts an item between a Jira issue and a Structure planning task: depending on strategy it creates the target item with copied field values, places it in the structure where the source row was (moving children), and/or deletes the source item. Requires edit access to the structure.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:conversion-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

create-structure-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the create-structure wizard pages: template choices, step state, step titles and buttons, and the step-specific fields of the backlog, personal backlog and agile templates.
contract_notes: Jira velocity method allowlist (velocity-allowlist module); entries name plugin methods by signature

custom-field-resolver.purpose: Finds a Jira custom field id by name (case- and space-insensitive, preferring exact matches), optionally restricted to fields in scope for an issue's project and type; results are cached.

customfield-provider.purpose: Serves typed values of Jira custom fields. Date fields give times, or localized text on request. Numeric fields give numbers, user fields give users, and most others give text. Some fields are handled specially: Agile sprint (comma-joined names), service desk request type, Tempo account and team, Advanced Roadmaps team and target dates, Epic Sum Up time, and Xray fields.
contract_notes: attribute id: customfield, param fieldId; formats text/time/number/user/duration

type keys handled: com.pyxis.greenhopper.jira:gh-sprint, com.atlassian.servicedesk:vp-origin, com.tempoplugin.tempo-accounts:accounts.customfield, com.tempoplugin.tempo-teams:team.customfield, com.atlassian.teams:rm-teams-custom-field-team, aptis.plugins.epicSumUp:epic-sum-up-custom-field-time; ignored searcher type com.keplerrominfo.jira.plugins.keplercf:silscriptcf

dark-features-rc.purpose: Script and styles for the Structure dark features admin page, which lists and edits Structure feature flags via REST.

dashboard-gadget-data-exporter.purpose: Collects all configured Structure dashboard gadgets (dashboard id, position, user preferences) whose structure is in the migration scope, for inclusion in cloud migration exports.
contract_notes: Gadget module key com.almworks.jira.structure:structure-gadget, gadget URI marker rest/gadgets/1.0/g/
Gadget preferences isConfigured, structureId, viewId, canvas-viewId

data-tracker.purpose: Forwards every issue change reported by the issue event bridge to the item tracker so that cached forests and attribute values for those issues are refreshed.

date-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a date-picker custom field on an issue to a date or clears it; for the Advanced Roadmaps target start/end fields it applies a UTC shift when needed. Undo restores the previous date.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:date-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

date-field-provider.purpose: Serves issue dates as time values: created, updated and resolution date. It also serves the due date. A date-only value, the due date can be corrected to the viewing user's time zone (date-shifted spec) or returned unshifted, depending on the spec's date-shift flag.
contract_notes: due date honours the date-shift spec parameter (shifted vs. disabled)

date-time-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a date-time custom field on an issue to a timestamp or clears it via a validated issue update; undo restores the previous value.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:date-time-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

delay-effect-provider.purpose: Test/diagnostic effect: waits a given number of milliseconds (default 100) when applied, for a given item, and produces an identical effect as its undo. Negative delays or missing item ids are errors.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:delay-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

delete-comment-effect-provider.purpose: Deletes a given issue comment if the current user may delete it; the undo re-adds a comment with the same body.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:delete-comment-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

dependency-watcher.purpose: Watches the Jira Software and Jira Service Management plugins; when they are installed, upgraded or removed it refreshes and restarts Structure so its optional integrations rewire, recording a flag to avoid repeated refreshes at startup.
contract_notes: Watched packages com.atlassian.greenhopper.api.rank (plugin com.pyxis.greenhopper.jira) and com.atlassian.servicedesk.api (plugin com.atlassian.servicedesk)

description-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Description text via a validated Jira issue update; empty and missing text are treated as equal; undo restores the previous description.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:description-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

details-common.purpose: Shared item-details components: field editors (text, date, rich text, summary) and expanders.

details-providers.purpose: Item details panel on the Structure Board for non-issue items: text and rich text editors and field helpers for generic items such as planning tasks and memos.

dialog-common.purpose: Shared modal dialog base and confirmation dialog used by Structure pages and the widget.

displayable-provider.purpose: Serves the localized 'displayable' text: a short description of any row item, used in messages and pickers. Examples are 'issue KEY: summary' (summary cut to 30 characters) and texts for new issues, folders, generators and effectors. It also covers projects, components, versions, issue constants, users, groups, labels, options, structures, loop markers, sprints, Tempo accounts, version names and generic items.
contract_notes: attribute id 'displayable' (text); depends on the user's locale

i18n key pattern s.ext.it.<kind>.displayable (kinds: issue, new-issue, folder, generator, effector, project, component, version, issuetype, status, resolution, priority, user, group, label, cfoption, structure, loopmarker, sprint, tempo-account, version-name)

done-provider.purpose: Serves the core 'done' boolean for issues. By default an issue is done when its status is in the Done status category. A dark feature switches the rule to 'the issue has a resolution'.

due-date-effect-provider.purpose: Sets or clears an issue's Due Date via a validated Jira issue update; values compared in Jira's date-picker format; undo restores the old date.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:due-date-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

editable-provider.purpose: Serves the core 'editable' boolean for each row item. Issues are editable when Jira lets the current user edit them. Folders and generic items (memos and similar) are editable when the user can edit the owning structure. Generators and effectors are editable when the user may configure automation in it. The value depends on the viewing user.
contract_notes: item types: com.almworks.jira.structure:type-folder, :type-generator, :type-effector, generic item types

effect-application-performance-log-provi.purpose: Adds an 'Effect applications' section to the performance audit log listing recent effect application runs per forest: status (running, stopped, success, failed) and per-effect-provider time and count.

effect-based-issue-movers.purpose: Implements what happens when a user drags an issue between groups of a field grouper (priority, components, versions, labels, assignee, reporter, status, sprint, custom fields): produces Jira update effects with notifications, or blocks moves for fields that cannot change.

effect-observer.purpose: Keeps bounded in-memory logs of recent effector preparation and application runs (what, for whom, status, times and counts) for the performance audit log.

effect-preparation-performance-log-provi.purpose: Adds an 'Effect preparations' section to the performance audit log listing recent effect preparation (preview) runs per forest with status and per-provider time and count.

effect-provider-helper.purpose: Shared toolkit for effect providers that write issue field values: identifies fields, builds update-issue effects with undo, compares old and new values, merges conflicting grouped effects and renders effect descriptions as HTML with conflict warnings.

effect-service.purpose: Public in-memory store of effect batches (pending changes produced by generator actions) for a user, identified by node-specific ids and discarded after about 71 seconds.

effector-attribute-to-field.purpose: Effector "Attribute to Field": writes an attribute or formula value into a chosen Jira field for issues in the structure (set, add or remove for multi-value fields), optionally limited by JQL and with or without email notifications.
contract_notes: params: attributeJson, fieldId, collectionOperation (set|add|remove), jql, sendNotifications

effector-audit.purpose: Page script for the effector audit page, listing effect records of a process via REST.

effector-common.purpose: Shared effector styles: process status icons and pagination.

effector-conversion.purpose: Effector "Conversion": converts planning tasks in the structure (all or selected ones) into real Jira issues, optionally keeping the planning task row instead of replacing it.

effector-delay.purpose: Test/diagnostic effector "Delay" that only waits for configured preview and apply durations in milliseconds.

effector-instance-manager.purpose: Public store of configured effector instances (an effector module key, its parameters and owning structure), with create, restore, read, update and delete and caching.

effector-process-io.purpose: Persists effector process state and effect records: process status transitions, preview, timestamps, owning user and node, and per-effect records with undo data; caches processes and running processes per user.
contract_notes: AO table EFFECTOR_PROCESS (C_STATUS, C_PARAMETERS, C_USER_KEY, C_PROCESS_HANDLE_ID, C_EFFECTOR_PREVIEW, C_CREATED, C_START_TIME, C_FINISH_TIME, C_QUEUED, C_ACKNOWLEDGED, C_NODE_ID)
AO table EFFECTOR_RECORD (C_PROCESS_ID, C_PREVIEW_INDEX, C_TIMESTAMP, C_EFFECT_MESSAGE, C_AFFECTED_ITEMS, C_UNDO_EFFECT, C_ERROR)

effector-process-manager.purpose: Public service that runs effectors (automation that writes changes back to Jira): validates permissions, starts processes for a structure's effector instances or a one-off effector, supports preview and confirmation, applying, cancelling, undo, resume of interrupted runs and acknowledgement; one node applies at a time in Data Center.
contract_notes: process parameter keys structureId, effectorInstances, oneOffEffectorModuleKey, oneOffParams, oneOffForestSpec, revertedProcessId

effector-processes.purpose: Page script for 'Manage Effectors': lists effector processes with filters (user picker), status, links to board and audit, and actions.

effector-status-rollup.purpose: Effector "Status Rollup": sets each parent issue's status to the earliest (in a configured order) status among its children, for selected projects and issue types, optionally setting a resolution, reporting warnings for unlisted or untransitionable issues.
contract_notes: params: projects, issueTypes, statuses, resolution, sendNotifications, screenCheck

empty-structure.purpose: Create Structure wizard template "Empty Structure": creates a structure with no content.

end-of-life.purpose: Banner script for administrators: reads license info from REST and shows error or warning hints when the Structure (or extension app) license or maintenance has expired or expires soon (a week for license, a month for maintenance).

end-of-life-decorator.purpose: Runs before page decoration on the Jira dashboard, admin pages, Structure admin pages and the Structure Board. For Jira administrators only, if the Structure license or its maintenance (or that of a bundled extension app) has expired or expires soon, it adds the end-of-life banner resource to the page.
contract_notes: location before-decoration; separate javax (Jira 9-10) and jakarta (Jira 11+) variants

enum-customfield-order-provider.purpose: Serves sort-order values for enumerated custom fields: select lists and cascading selects by option sequence, labels by first label, project pickers by project name, version pickers by project and version sequence, and user/group/Script Runner user fields by first name. It respects field-level security.
contract_notes: attribute id: customfield, format order, param fieldId (numeric custom field id)

environment-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Environment text via a validated Jira issue update; no-op if unchanged; undo restores the previous text.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:environment-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

epic-issue-provider.purpose: Serves two Agile epic-link attributes: the epic an issue belongs to, and the list of issues in an epic. Both are computed in bulk from the Agile epic link and respect what the user can see.

error-provider.purpose: Serves 'value-expand'. It wraps another attribute's value as a small JSON object: the value itself, an 'undefined' flag, or an 'error' with the formula error code (-1 if unknown). The client can then tell errors apart from empty values.

event-bridge.purpose: Public issue event bridge: listens to Jira issue, issue-link, remote-link and issue-property events and redistributes them to Structure's issue listeners; also lets other code report issue changes explicitly.

events.purpose: Defines the shared set of front-end application event identifiers used by the structure widget and pages to communicate (loading, edits, selection, view changes, polling, dialogs, etc.).
contract_notes: AMD module id structure/AppEvents (also exposed globally) may be used by extension apps

excel-export.purpose: Servlet that exports a structure as an Excel workbook. Takes a forest specification (JSON), view id or view spec, expansion state, client-side filter and an xlsx flag; builds a workbook with the view's columns and returns it as an attachment (.xls or .xlsx). Maps failures to 400/403/404/500, or 503 when automation failed, and counts the user as active.
contract_notes: Parameters: forestSpec, viewId, viewSpec, expand, clientFilter, xlsx, s

export-structure-as-json.purpose: Developer-mode-only entry 'View as JSON' in the Structure Board's export menu, linking to the forest REST resource for the current forest specification.
contract_notes: section structure.export.menu (web-item location read by the widget-config REST to build the board's Export menu; other plugins may add items there)

exportrenderer-attribute.purpose: Exports a generic 'attribute' column whose parameters carry an arbitrary attribute spec. The value is exported as HTML (rich text in Excel) when the attribute is HTML or can be converted to HTML, and as plain text otherwise. A column without an attribute is rejected.
contract_notes: column key 'attribute'; column params hold a nested attribute spec ('attribute')

exportrenderer-comment.purpose: Exports the Last Comment column: the HTML of the latest comment the user can see on each issue. It is rich text in Excel and a wrapping cell in print.

exportrenderer-excel-field.purpose: Builds the Excel cell renderer for an exported Jira field column, or a summed time-aggregate field column. Issue keys become hyperlinks. Number, date, date-time, duration, URL, vote and watch fields get typed, right-aligned or linked cells. Other fields become rich text from their HTML value. Thumbnail fields are skipped. With aggregate=sum the sub-tree sum is exported.
contract_notes: column params: 'field' (required Jira field id), 'aggregate' (only 'sum' allowed), 'distinct'

exportrenderer-excel-joined.purpose: When a combined-fields ('joined') or 'icons' column is exported to Excel, splits it into one separate spreadsheet column per listed Jira field, each rendered the same way as a single field column.

exportrenderer-formula.purpose: Exports Formula columns by evaluating the formula and its variables, or their sub-tree sum when aggregate=sum (arrays are summed first). The display format sets the cell type: number or percentage (rounded to 0-9 digits), date or date-time, duration (work or calendar time), wiki-rendered HTML, or wrapping text. The default header is the formula's first 15 characters.
contract_notes: column params: formula, variables, displayFormat (or legacy numberFormat) with type number|percentage|datetime|duration|wiki, style, rounding, workTime; aggregate ('sum'), distinct

exportrenderer-itemid.purpose: Exports the item-id column. Issues show their numeric issue id. Other items show their item identity, with the item type written in simplified form.

exportrenderer-main.purpose: Renders the main 'Summary' column for both export formats, using the aggregated summary attribute. In Excel the cell is indented by the row's depth in the hierarchy. In print it is a padded, wrapping cell. Rows whose item failed to load show a 'loading failed' text.
contract_notes: i18n key s.w.item-loading-failed; printable header CSS class 's-mn'

exportrenderer-notes.purpose: Exports the Notes column: the per-structure text note stored for each item under the column's note name (default 'notes'), shown as wrapping text.

exportrenderer-print-field.purpose: Renders a Jira field column (or a summed time-aggregate field column) in the printable HTML export, using the field's HTML value. Long fields (links, labels, environment, description, custom fields) wrap over several lines. For user fields, the column's 'view' option is passed on.

exportrenderer-print-icons.purpose: Renders an 'icons' column in the printable export as a cell of small icons for the chosen fields: issue type, priority, status, assignee, reporter and project. An unsupported field id or an empty field list is an error.
contract_notes: column param 'fields' with allowed values issuetype, priority, status, assignee, reporter, project
cell CSS class 's-icons'; default header i18n key sw.column.type.icons

exportrenderer-print-joined.purpose: Renders a combined-fields ('joined') column in the printable export as one cell with the HTML values of all listed fields joined together. A column name written in braces is treated as an i18n key and translated.

exportrenderer-progress.purpose: Renders the Progress column in exports by requesting the progress attribute with the column's settings. Excel gets a percentage cell. Print shows a progress bar, or percent text when the column is set to display percents.
contract_notes: column params passed to the progress attribute: basedOn, resolvedComplete, includeSelf, weightBy, weightByField, statuses+percents (basedOn=status), categories+categoryPercents (basedOn=category), percentField (basedOn=percentfield); display param displayPercents

exportrenderer-querymatch.purpose: Exports the Query Match column. The printable export shows the match marker HTML. Excel shows 1/0. With aggregate=sum it shows the count of matching rows in the sub-tree. The header defaults to the query text if it is 40 characters or fewer, otherwise to a name based on the query type.
contract_notes: column key 'query-match'; params query, queryType, aggregate ('sum'), distinct
header i18n keys s.w.query-match.column-type.name and s.w.query-match.column.<queryType>.name

exportrenderer-rowid.purpose: Exports the row-id column: the numeric forest row id of each exported row.

exportrenderer-seq.purpose: Exports the sequence-number column: the hierarchical outline number of each row, such as 1.2.3.

exportrenderer-tempo-timeplanned.purpose: When the Tempo Planner API is installed, exports the Tempo Time Planned column as a duration for the column's date range, filtered by users, teams and roles. With aggregate=sum it exports the sub-tree sum. Without a date range the column is skipped.
contract_notes: column key 'tempo-timeplanned'; params dateFrom, dateTo (required), users, teams, roles, aggregate ('sum'), distinct

exportrenderer-tempo-worklogged.purpose: When Tempo Timesheets is installed, exports the Tempo Work Logged column as a duration. It asks for the Tempo logged-time attribute for the column's date range, filtered by accounts, users, teams and billable. With aggregate=sum it exports the sub-tree sum. Without a date range the column is skipped.
contract_notes: column key 'tempo-worklogged'; params dateFrom, dateTo (required), accounts, billable, users, teams, aggregate ('sum'), distinct

exportrenderer-timeinstatus.purpose: Exports the Time in Status column. It passes the column's status selection, reopen, target-status, current-status and calendar options to the time-in-status attribute. The cell is a duration (calendar time unless work time is chosen) or a plain number, depending on the display format. With aggregate=sum it exports the sub-tree sum.
contract_notes: params forwarded to the attribute: statuses, useCurrentStatus, reopen, targetEnabled, targetStatuses, calendar; also displayFormat.type ('duration'), workTime, aggregate ('sum'), distinct

exportrenderer-worklogged.purpose: Renders the 'Work Logged' column in exports as a duration cell. It asks for the logged-time attribute with the column's period (a named preset or an explicit from/to range), time zone, and optional author, group or role filter. With aggregate=sum it exports the sub-tree sum. Without a valid period the column is skipped.
contract_notes: column params: period, dateFrom, dateTo, timeZone, author|group|role, aggregate ('sum'), distinct

expr-aggregation-provider.purpose: Supplies the formula language's aggregate functions over a row's subtree or other scopes (sum, count, min, max, average, median, percentile, quartile, join, array, unique min/max) with documentation links.
contract_notes: aggregate names sum, count, min, max, umin, umax, avg/average, median, percentile, quartile, join, array

expr-attribute.purpose: Serves formula ('expr') attributes, the engine behind Formula columns. It parses the Structure expression language and binds named variables to other attribute specs. It pulls in any aggregations the formula uses and converts the result to the requested format, text by default. Automation and loop-marker rows are skipped. Caching follows the formula's dependence on user, locale, time zone and time.
contract_notes: attribute id: expr; params formula, variables (name -> attribute spec), debug

expr-constraints.purpose: Holds the limit on array size in formula (Expr) evaluation, read from configuration.

expr-function-provider.purpose: Supplies the formula language's standard function library (logic, comparison, arithmetic, rounding, math, text, regex, date and time, user, field and Jira entity lookups) with aliases and documentation links.

expr-function-services.purpose: Bundle of Jira services (time zones, i18n, time-tracking configuration, date-time formatter factory, extension registry) made available to formula functions at evaluation time.

expr-parser.purpose: Parses and analyzes formula-language (Expr) expressions: prepares executors, reports syntax errors with expected tokens, lists variables and dependencies, and lists the available functions and aggregations with canonical names.

extended-value-tools.purpose: Helper for generic attribute values (number, string, boolean, item reference, list, map): dispatches on value kind and rewrites an attribute request for a custom field of the Epic Link type into the epic attribute, then asks for the value in a generic format. Used by formulas, generic item fields and effectors.

extender-agile.purpose: Extender "Stories under Epics": adds issues belonging to each epic under the epic. Placing issues under an epic adds them to it (sub-tasks and epics cannot be added); reordering is not supported.

extender-links.purpose: Extender "Linked Issues": adds issues linked by a chosen link type and direction under each issue. Dropping an issue under another creates a link of that type; moving changes links; reordering is not supported.

extender-portfolio-children.purpose: Extender for Advanced Roadmaps (Portfolio): adds issues whose Parent Link points to an issue under that issue; moving issues under another parent changes the Parent Link; reordering is not supported.

extender-subtasks.purpose: Extender "Sub-tasks": adds sub-tasks (optionally only selected sub-task types) under their parent issues. Moving a sub-task under another issue changes its parent; reordering changes sub-task order, subject to permissions and project rules.

extension-service.purpose: Central registry of Structure extension modules declared by this and other plugins (item types, generators, effectors, effect providers, attribute loader providers, export renderers, synchronizers, S-JQL constraints, backup, calendar, performance log and integration-details providers). Tracks module enable/disable events and versions the lists.
contract_notes: S-JQL constraint names must match [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ and not be S-JQL keywords

favorite-manager.purpose: Stores which structures each user marked as favorite and computes structure popularity (number of users who favorited it); lists a user's favorites (optionally including archived), sorts and filters structures by popularity, removes entries for vanished users or structures, and deletes a user's favorites on anonymization.
contract_notes: AO table FAVORITES with columns C_USER_KEY, C_STRUCTURE_ID

favoriteEditor.purpose: Favorite toggle field on the edit structure page.

favorites.purpose: Favorite-star toggle for structures in lists and the board, calling the structure favorite REST endpoint and showing flags.

field-information-provider.purpose: Registry describing how each Jira system field and supported custom field type can be read, parsed from text and written by effects (users, priority, status, resolution, versions, components, labels, sprints, options, groups, teams, etc.), with localized errors for unknown values.

field-value-options.purpose: Provides searchable option lists for Jira fields (project, status, issue type, versions, priority, users, labels, components, resolution, custom field options, cascading options, groups) and builds JQL for chosen options; serves the issue-field options REST endpoint and the field filter.
contract_notes: special option id special:EMPTY, prefixes author:, group:

filter-attribute.purpose: Filter "Attribute": keeps items whose attribute or formula value satisfies a chosen operator and value (including date and duration comparisons).

filter-by-field.purpose: Filter "Field" (quick filter): keeps issues whose chosen field has one of the selected values, optionally keeping non-issue rows.

filter-inserter-extender-duplicates.purpose: Non-configurable filter "Remove Inserter/Extender Duplicates": hides top-level inserted items that already appear as extender-added children elsewhere; offered as a preset at level 1.

filter-item.purpose: Unlisted filter that keeps only rows showing one specific item; used to "pin" a single item view of a structure.
contract_notes: module referenced by full key {P}filter-item in forest spec transformations

filter-jql.purpose: Filter "JQL Query": keeps issues matching a JQL query, optionally keeping non-issue rows.

filter-number-attribute.purpose: Unlisted filter that keeps rows whose numeric attribute value lies within an optional minimum and maximum; rows without a value are hidden.

filter-sjql.purpose: Filter "S-JQL Query": keeps rows matching a Structure query (S-JQL) evaluated over the generated forest, ignoring automation rows.

filter-sprint.purpose: Filter "Sprint": shows only sprint groups in selected states (active, future, closed, backlog/no sprint); available with Jira Software; preset "Hide Closed Sprints".
contract_notes: params: boolean flags per state: active, future, closed, backlog

filter-text.purpose: Filter "Text Query": keeps issues matching a text search and non-issue items whose key or summary match the text.

filtersync-config-js.purpose: Form logic for the filter synchronizer configuration (filter picker).

fix-versions-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes or sets an issue's Fix Version/s with the same project and archived-version rules as Affects Versions; used e.g. when moving issues between version groups. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:fix-versions-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue', 'add', 'remove', 'set' (lists of value keys; add/remove are mutually exclusive with set), 'conflicts', 'sendNotifications'

folder-manager.purpose: Public store of folder items (name and owning structure) used to group rows in a structure, with caching and change tracking.

fonts.purpose: Icon fonts (Font Awesome and the Structure icon font).

forest-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds a 'Forest caches' section to the performance audit log describing cached forests in the general and pinned caches: version, row count, unique item count, item types and row counts per depth.

forest-permissions-cache.purpose: Public cache answering which rows, issues and items of a forest are invisible to a given user, checking issue visibility via Jira search and other item types via their own access checks.

forest-service.purpose: Public service that resolves a forest specification (stored structure, query, transformed or secured view, clipboard) to a live forest source, applying generators and transformations, caching sources, and naming forests for display.

forest-stats-container.purpose: Collects statistics about cached forests (general and pinned caches): version, row count, unique items, item types and depth distribution, for the performance audit log.

forest-update-observer.purpose: Keeps a bounded in-memory log (default 400 entries) of recent forest recalculations: full or incremental, versions, timings and change summaries per generation step, for the performance audit log.

forest-update-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds a 'Forest changes updates' section to the performance audit log with recent full/incremental forest updates: forest, version range, status, changes and timings.

forest-update-statistics-collector.purpose: Records the largest forest size updated within each statistics period and reports it, bucketed by size, to usage statistics.

format-helper.purpose: Formats dates and durations for display: named date styles (date-short, date-long, date-full, datetime-short, datetime-long, jira-date, jira-datetime) in the current user's locale, Jira time-tracking duration formatting and parsing, and calendar-time duration parsing.
contract_notes: date style ids date-short (default), date-long, date-full, datetime-short, datetime-long, jira-date, jira-datetime

formatted-number-provider.purpose: Serves 'formatted-number': another attribute's value turned into display text using display-format settings such as number, percentage, date/time, duration and rounding. It uses the user's locale and time zone. Formula columns use it.
contract_notes: attribute id 'formatted-number' (text); params: 'attribute' (dependency), 'type' (e.g. number, percentage, datetime, duration) and the formatting options of a formula display format

formula-icons.purpose: Static icon images that formulas can reference through the structure icon URL function.
contract_notes: resource names partly-cloudy, shine, spacer, thunderbolt; formula function STRUCTURE_ICON_URL(name) returns their absolute URLs

gadget-bare.purpose: Structure gadget code and styles without dependencies: initialization, configuration form, remote gadget extension for subscriptions.

gadget-resources.purpose: Complete resource set for the Structure dashboard gadget.

generation-manager.purpose: Tracks running generations of automated forests per forest specification, can block regeneration, and enforces generation time limits (global default 30 s, per-structure override, hard maximum).
contract_notes: dark feature structure.gfs.generationTimeHardLimit (default 10 min, max 30 min)

generator-manager.purpose: Public generator service: creates, updates, deletes and looks up generators, routing to the persistent store or the in-memory transient store by id, resolves a generator spec to its extension module, and records changes for tracking.
contract_notes: generator ids: odd positive = transient, even positive = persistent

generic-item-attribute-provider.purpose: Serves the core attributes project, type, priority, reporter and assignee for memos and planning tasks, read from Structure's own copies of those fields on the item.
contract_notes: attribute ids 'project', 'type', 'priority', 'reporter', 'assignee' (native object formats) for generic item types

generic-item-field-accessor-manager.purpose: Builds field-level read views and update builders over generic items (memos, planning tasks), combining the stored item with the per-type field configuration and the structure field definitions, including agile (sprint) fields. Used by the memo and planning-task managers.

generic-item-field-config-service.purpose: Decides which fields a generic item has and validates field updates. Memos expose a fixed small set (summary, description, assignee, due date, original/remaining estimate, time spent); planning tasks mirror the field configuration of their Jira project and issue type, inject required fields, and supply option lists for pickers.
contract_notes: i18n errors s.ext.type.memo.error.project-not-found / project-required / issue-type-not-found / issue-type-required

generic-item-fields-provider.purpose: Serves field values for Structure's own items, memos and planning tasks. For any attribute that maps to a field Structure manages, it reads that field from the item. The value comes as text, HTML (users as links, with an Excel variant) or the field's own value type, with time-zone handling for date fields.
contract_notes: attribute ids = issue-field-style ids of Structure fields (mapped from the attribute spec)

generic-item-history-based-fields-provid.purpose: For memos and planning tasks, works out 'creator', 'created' and 'updated' by replaying the item's history. The creator is available as a user key, a user item or user HTML.
contract_notes: attribute ids 'creator' (text key / value / html with param 'view'), 'created', 'updated' (time)

generic-item-history-manager.purpose: Persists and serves the change history of generic items: one record per create or update with old and new name, description and parameters, author and timestamp. Records are cached and can be queried per item in time order; this feeds the memo change-history view.
contract_notes: AO table GENERIC_ITEM_HISTORY (C_LONG_ID, C_TYPE_ID, C_OLD_NAME, C_OLD_DESCRIPTION, C_OLD_PARAMETERS, C_NEW_NAME, C_NEW_DESCRIPTION, C_NEW_PARAMETERS, C_AUTHOR, C_TIMESTAMP, C_CREATE)

generic-item-history-provider.purpose: Serves 'history' for memos and planning tasks: the list of change-history record groups stored for the item, loaded in bulk from Structure's history store for these items.

generic-item-manager.purpose: Public store for 'generic items' (memos, planning tasks and other plugin-defined item types): creates, reads, updates, deletes and restores them in the database, caches them, records an audit history entry on every change and notifies the item tracker. Items may be owned by a structure, in which case visibility follows that structure's view permission.
contract_notes: AO table GENERIC_ITEM (columns C_NAME, C_OWNING_STRUCTURE, C_DESCRIPTION, C_PARAMETERS as JSON, C_TYPE_ID)
Public API component exported as GenericItemManager

generic-item-service.purpose: Public validated create/update/delete service for generic items. Checks licence, that the user may use Structure, that the user is not anonymous for creation, item existence, and edit permission on the owning structure before delegating to the generic item manager; returns validation results with errors.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as GenericItemService

generic-item-type-helper.purpose: Shared logic for generic items (memos, planning tasks): exposes key, name, summary, description, created, updated, creator and history to formulas, parses edits, and builds item keys and board links.

gh-integration.purpose: Integration with Jira Software (agile): detects the agile app and version, locates Epic Name, Epic Link and Sprint fields, the epic issue type and link type, resolves epics, lists boards and their filters/projects, formats sprint names with state, and checks rank, sprint and epic change permissions.
contract_notes: Jira Software plugin key com.pyxis.greenhopper.jira; sprint field type key com.pyxis.greenhopper.jira:gh-sprint

ghTab.purpose: Script for the Structure tab on Agile board issue details: creates a compact widget anchored on the selected issue, remembers chosen structure and pin state per board, re-lays out on board resize and reloads the board after edits.

ghsync-config-js.purpose: Form logic for the Agile synchronizer configuration.

goto.structure.purpose: Global keyboard shortcut 'g' then 's' ('Open Structure') that follows the Structure top-menu link to the Structure Board.

greenhopper-tab.purpose: Adds a 'Structure' tab to the issue detail view on Jira Software (Agile) boards. It renders an empty container that the Agile-board script fills with a structure widget anchored on the selected issue. Shown only if Structure is enabled for issue pages, the user may use Structure, the issue's project is enabled and non-archived structures exist.

grouper-agile-epic.purpose: Grouper "Epic": groups issues under their epic, optionally sorting epics by a rank field. Moving issues between epics changes epic membership; reordering epics changes their rank.

grouper-field.purpose: Grouper "Issue Field": groups items by the value of a chosen field (project, type, status, priority, resolution, users, components, versions, labels, select/user/group custom fields, issue picker, Insight objects, request type). Moving items between groups updates the field (status via workflow transition) when allowed.
contract_notes: param: fieldId (system field id or customfield_N)

grouper-links.purpose: Grouper "Issue Links": groups each issue under the issue it is linked to by a chosen link type and direction; moving issues between groups changes the links.

grouper-portfolio-parent.purpose: Grouper that places issues under their Advanced Roadmaps (Portfolio) parent issue, with a "No parent" group; moving an issue to another group changes its Parent Link.

grouper-sprint.purpose: Grouper "Sprint": groups issues by sprint. Moving an issue to another sprint group changes its sprint, except into or out of closed sprints or to a board the issue does not belong to.

grouper-tempo-account.purpose: Grouper "Tempo Account": groups issues by Tempo account (optionally including closed and archived accounts), with a "No account" group; moving issues between groups changes their account.

grouper-text.purpose: Grouper "Attribute": groups items by the value of any attribute or formula, with a "No value" group; grouping is read-only (moving items does not change data). Offers a preset for grouping by sprint name across projects.

grouper-version-name.purpose: Grouper "Version Name": groups issues and planning tasks by fix or affected version name across projects; moving items between groups changes their versions, blocked when the name maps to several versions in a project.

help-content-manager.purpose: Stores administrator-defined help content for the Structure welcome/help screen (title, wiki content, list of contact users) as JSON in a plugin property, returns it with contact user details, and reports whether help tips are defined to statistics.
contract_notes: plugin property welcomeScreen.help (JSON with title, content, contactKeys)

help-rc.purpose: Styles for the Help Tool admin pages (view, edit, preview of custom help content).

help-widget.purpose: Styles for the help widget showing custom help content and contacts.

helper.purpose: Public general-purpose helper service: fetches issues with permission and project-enablement checks, checks Structure app permissions and admin rights, runs JQL searches and issue matching, lists visible projects, groups and roles, and requires the plugin's web resources (widget, issue details, quick edit) on pages.

hidden-links-helper.purpose: Classifies issue link types: sub-task and epic link types are internal; other system link types are 'hidden' and offered to users only when the hidden-links feature flag is on. Used where link types are listed or followed.

hints.purpose: Support for dismissible global hint banners: styles and a helper that remembers dismissed messages in browser storage or cookies.

history-recorder.purpose: Collects forest changes during structure updates and commits them as versioned history entries (with user and synchronizer), supporting batches, cancellation, restoring entries from backup, clearing history for a structure or version range, batch listeners, anonymization counts and user-key renames.

history-recorder-io.purpose: Database writer for structure change history: writes a history entry (previous version, timestamp, user, synchronizer) with its forest changes (operation, moved forest, source/target paths and positions, direction, original rows), writes issue and project index rows per entry, deletes ranges of history, counts and renames user keys.
contract_notes: AO tables HISTORY_ENTRY (C_ID, C_PREV_VERSION, C_TIMESTAMP, C_USER_KEY, C_SYNCHRONIZER), HISTORY_CHANGE (C_HID, C_OPERATION, C_FOREST, C_PATH_FROM, C_AFTER_FROM, C_PATH_TO, C_AFTER_TO, C_DIRECTION, C_ORIGINAL_ROWS), HISTORY_ISSUE (C_HID, C_ISSUE_ID), HISTORY_PROJECT (C_HID, C_PROJECT_ID)

history-service.purpose: Read side of structure history: returns history entries for a structure between versions, latest version, entry counts (optionally since a date), reconstructs a forest as of a past version, and runs activity queries (by structures, issues, projects, users, time) with limits for activity streams and the history REST API.

http-request-emulator.purpose: Installs and clears a fake current HTTP request on non-request threads so Jira code that expects one works in background jobs; Jira-version-specific (javax/jakarta).

http-servlet-variables-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter exposing the current HTTP request and response in the common bridged form.

icon-provider.purpose: Serves the core 'icon' HTML attribute for many item types. Examples: the issue-type icon for issues, the project avatar, the user avatar, status/type/priority icons, and version icons (released and archived variants). Generators, effectors, service desk request types, generic items and Insight objects get icons too. It also serves per-field icon attributes for the icons column and the printable export.
contract_notes: attribute ids (HTML): icon, project.icon, assignee.icon, reporter.icon, issuetype.icon, priority.icon, status.icon, run-as-user.icon; param print=true on assignee.icon / reporter.icon gives a printable variant
generic item parameters iconClass and color -> CSS classes 'alm alm-fw <icon>' and 's-item-color-<color>'

index-flusher.purpose: Clears Jira's thread-local index searchers so later searches see fresh index data; Jira-version-specific.

index-monitor-cf-searcher.purpose: Searcher paired with the Structure Index Monitor field; its indexer hook reports every issue reindex to Structure's item change tracking. Not intended for users to search with.
contract_notes: valid for custom field type index-monitor-cf-type

index-monitor-cf-type.purpose: Locked internal custom field type "Structure Index Monitor" that stores no data; a single global field of this type is created automatically so that its indexer is invoked whenever Jira reindexes an issue, letting Structure notice reindexing (used on Data Center).
contract_notes: custom field name "Structure Index Monitor", managed and locked

index-search-service.purpose: Version-specific adapter for searching Jira's issue index: returns matching issue ids, streams ids or single/multi field values for a query and user, exposes the max clause count and doc-values reading.

inserter-jql.purpose: Inserter "JQL Query": inserts issues matching a JQL query (up to a configurable limit, default 1000). Users may add only matching issues at the top level; moving or removing issues inside the result is blocked.

inserter-recent-issues.purpose: Unlisted inserter that inserts the issues the current user viewed recently (newest first), refreshed about once a minute; used for recent-issue search results.

inserter-substructure.purpose: Inserter "Structure": inserts the contents of another structure (optionally a sub-tree from a given row, optionally with a given user's security), and passes edits made inside it through to the source structure when the user has edit or automate permission there.
contract_notes: params: forestSpec{structureId,...}, rowId, reuseRows, security{userKey, secured}

inserter-text.purpose: Inserter "Text Query": inserts issues found by a text search (sorted by issue key descending, limited); add/move/remove rules are the same as for the JQL inserter.

insight-expr-converter.purpose: Converts Insight/Assets object attribute values into formula values: dates shifted to the user's time zone, date-times as timestamps, text areas stripped of HTML, and referenced objects, users, groups, versions and projects turned into item references; statuses become names.

insight-integration-supplier.purpose: Supplies a shared, lazily-resolved bridge to the Insight/Assets app (if installed) used to load objects, their attributes, status names, objects selectable in Insight custom fields, and permission checks.

insight-object-custom-field-effect-provi.purpose: Adds, removes or sets Insight/Assets objects (by object key) in an Insight object custom field on an issue; unknown object keys are errors. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:insight-object-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

is-user-added-automation-provider.purpose: For generator and effector rows, says whether a user added that automation to the saved structure, rather than it being produced by another generator. Transient rows are traced back to the original. The value is the automation's item identity, or undefined.
contract_notes: attribute id: user-added-automation (format user-added-automation, value item identity)

issue-change-interceptor.purpose: Wraps Jira requests that change issues without firing normal issue events: Agile ranking, sub-task reordering, voting/watching and watcher REST calls, Agile epic add/remove and the sub-task move REST call. It gathers affected issue ids or keys (parameters, URL or captured JSON body) and afterwards reports them to Structure's change tracking as rank, reorder or update changes.

issue-cloner.purpose: Bulk-clones a set of issues (used when copying a structure with issue cloning): validates permissions, target project, issue types, required fields, components, versions and options, then creates clones with optional link, attachments, sub-tasks, epic and parent handling, reporting localized errors and warnings with progress.
contract_notes: Jira property jira.clone.linktype.name for the clone link type

issue-comment-provider.purpose: Serves 'comment': the last comment on an issue that the current user can see, loaded in bulk. As HTML it uses the renderer set for the comment field; as text it is the raw body.

issue-constant-icon-cache.purpose: Short-lived cache (about 5 minutes) of rendered HTML image tags for Jira issue constants (issue type, priority, status, resolution) per locale, making relative icon URLs absolute. Used when rendering cells and exports.

issue-details.purpose: Issue details panel on the Structure Board: shows a selected issue using Jira's issue viewer and adjusts Jira's issue dialogs to work inside Structure.
contract_notes: required by board pages together with web-resource context jira.view.issue

issue-field-item-provider.purpose: Serves item-based values of issue fields, such as versions, components, users, options and attachments. Values are single item references or lists of them, in the generic value format that formulas can follow.
contract_notes: format 'value'; attribute id attachments -> Jira field attachment

issue-field-order-provider.purpose: Serves sort-order values for standard issue fields, so Structure sorts the way Jira does. Keys sort by project key, then number. Status, resolution and priority use Jira's sequence, with priority reversed. Users and projects sort by name, components and labels by their names, and versions by sequence. Dates, time tracking, votes, watches and work ratio sort by raw value.
contract_notes: format: order; field ids: issuekey, votes, watches, issuetype, status, resolution, priority, description, environment, duedate, resolutiondate, created, updated, timespent, timeoriginalestimate, timeestimate, workratio, assignee, creator, reporter, project, components, labels, fixVersions, versions

issue-field-provider.purpose: Serves basic issue attributes as native Jira objects, each with a trail so that changes to them invalidate dependent values. Covered are issue type, priority, project, status, assignee, reporter and creator. It also serves votes and watches counts, the issue id as text, and project, issue type and status ids.
contract_notes: attribute ids: type, priority, project, status, assignee, reporter, creator (object formats issuetype/priority/project/status/user); votes, watches (number); id (format id); project, issuetype, status (format id)

issue-field-rendering-provider.purpose: Serves the HTML of any Jira issue field the user can see, as Jira's navigator shows it. Time-tracking and Epic Sum Up time fields show as durations. User fields use the user renderer and honour a 'view' param. The service desk request type shows as icon plus name. An 'excel' param gives plain text without links for spreadsheet export.
contract_notes: attribute spec: issue field id in format html; params excel (bool), view (user fields)
Epic Sum Up custom field type key aptis.plugins.epicSumUp:epic-sum-up-custom-field-time

issue-field-text-provider.purpose: Serves plain-text values of standard issue fields for use in formulas and text. It covers affects and fix versions, components, assignee, reporter, creator, description, environment, issue type, labels, priority, project, resolution, security level and status.
contract_notes: format text; field ids versions, fixVersions, components, assignee, reporter, creator, description, environment, issuetype, labels, priority, project, resolution, security, status

issue-link-objects-provider.purpose: For issues, returns the list of Jira issue links on the issue, as link items, keeping only links whose other end the user can see. 'issuelinkobjects' leaves out system link types and 'allissuelinkobjects' keeps them. Links are ordered as Jira orders them and loaded in bulk.
contract_notes: attribute ids 'issuelinkobjects' and 'allissuelinkobjects' (value format: item-identity list)

issue-links-bulk-source.purpose: Reads issue links in bulk straight from Jira's entity store for many issues at once, by direction and optional link type, with optional ordering, batching large id lists; used by link-based generators and synchronizers.
contract_notes: Jira entity IssueLink fields source, destination, linktype, sequence

issue-links-support.purpose: Shared support for link-based generators: lists visible and hidden link types, validates link type and direction parameters on generator forms, builds summaries, and creates or removes Jira issue links when users move rows under link extenders and groupers.
contract_notes: generator parameters linkTypeId, direction (inward/outward), inward, shortestPaths

issue-parent-provider.purpose: Serves 'parent': for a sub-task, the item identity of its parent issue. For other issues it is undefined.

issue-reindex-tracker.purpose: Tracks Jira issue, project and full reindexes (fed by the index monitor field and reindex events) and notifies internal listeners so item tracking and synchronizers can react to reindexed issues.

issue-time-field-provider.purpose: Serves the issue time-tracking values time spent, remaining estimate and original estimate as durations, converting Jira's seconds to milliseconds.

issue-to-planning-task-converter.purpose: Copies an issue's project, issue type and visible field values into a planning task (or computes the list of field updates), mapping Jira field values to Structure fields; used when converting issues to planning tasks.

issuePageDecorator.purpose: Script for the Jira issue view: builds the Structure section in the issue page, its settings dialog, and the Structure time-tracking section (loaded from the server).

item-identity-mapper.purpose: In-memory bidirectional mapping of item identities to compact integer codes: issues map to their positive id, other items get negative codes assigned on demand. Used for memory-efficient transient rows.

item-property-editors.purpose: Resolves an editor for an item property name: the built-in default 'notes' property or a stored note ('dc_note_<n>'), so the item update REST call can edit note cells with permission checks and archived-note protection.
contract_notes: Property names 'notes' and 'dc_note_<n>' accepted by REST /rest/structure/2.0/item/update

item-provider.purpose: Serves the core 'item' attribute: the item object behind a row (issue, project, user, folder and so on). There are two variants: an extended-value form that may be cached, and a raw-object form that is never cached. Many other attributes depend on it.
contract_notes: attribute id 'item' (format any; also the extended 'value' format)

item-query-constraint.purpose: S-JQL constraint 'item' that matches rows by item type (standard short names or full module keys, '*' for all) and optionally by text or regular expression on the item's display text.
contract_notes: short type names map to com.almworks.jira.structure:type-<name>

item-resolver.purpose: Public service that turns item identities into the actual objects (issues, projects, users, generic items, etc.) by delegating to the registered item types, in bulk where supported, checking visibility for the current user and returning nothing for unknown or inaccessible items.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as ItemResolver

item-tracker.purpose: Public change-tracking service: other modules record that items changed and consumers ask for all changed items since a data version. On a single node it is in-memory; on Data Center changes are written to a shared table so all nodes see them, and issue reindex activity is taken into account.
contract_notes: AO tables ITEM_EVENTS_V2 and NODE_SIGNS_V2 (cluster change journal)
Public API component exported as ItemTracker

item-tracker-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds the item change tracker's state to the performance audit log (node id, node signature, thread count, pending event queue size) when the active tracker supports it.

item-type-registry.purpose: Persistent mapping between item type keys (complete plugin module keys of item types) and compact integer ids used in other tables. Preloads and caches all registrations and creates new ones optimistically with retries under concurrency.
contract_notes: Integer type ids are stored in ROW, GENERIC_ITEM, GENERIC_ITEM_HISTORY and item-property keys

jira-components.purpose: Static access point to standard Jira services (authentication context, project, component, version, constants, options, user managers, OSGi lookups) for code that cannot receive them by injection.
contract_notes: Part of the public API library (util package)

jira-configuration-cache.purpose: Caches Jira-wide configuration lookups (default locale, set of navigable field ids) and clears them on general configuration change events and every 5 minutes.
