jira-field-visibility-service.purpose: Computes, per project, issue type and user, whether a Jira field is visible, required or editable for planning tasks, following the Jira field configuration and the create-issue screen; project and issue type are always required, time-tracking fields map to Jira's time tracking field. Also checks project visibility; results are cached briefly.

jira-helper-factory.purpose: Version-specific factory for the Jira helper objects used when evaluating web fragments (request, optional project and context parameters).

jira-thread-env-factory.purpose: Creates a per-thread Jira environment for background jobs: prepares Jira's thread-local state and, unless disabled, installs an emulated HTTP request (with the base URL's context path) so request-dependent Jira code works; cleans up afterwards.

job-manager.purpose: Public background job manager with named thread pools: user (3), indexing (2), system (1), and generator, attribute and effector pools sized by configuration. Jobs run with the submitting user's identity and can be queried or cancelled.
contract_notes: Pool ids user, indexing, system, generator, attribute, effector
Public API component exported as StructureJobManager

jql-structure.purpose: JQL function structure(): returns issues in a structure. With no arguments uses the default structure; one argument is a structure name/id or an S-JQL query; two arguments are structure and S-JQL query. Reports errors for unknown, ambiguous or blocked structures.

jquery.purpose: Bundled jQuery 3.5.1 isolated for Structure scripts.

jquery-ui.purpose: Bundled jQuery UI 1.13.2 with theme and hover-intent plugin.

jsutil.purpose: Core front-end utility library used by nearly all Structure scripts (DOM, AJAX, templates, logging, i18n access), depending on the bundled jQuery, event ids and AUI pieces.

key-provider.purpose: Serves the core 'key' attribute: the issue or project key, the user name for users, a Structure-generated key for memos and planning tasks, and the object key for Insight (Assets) objects.
contract_notes: item types com.almworks.jira.structure:type-issue, type-project, type-user, type-memo, type-planning-task, type-insight-object

labels-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes, replaces or sets the system Labels of an issue through Jira's label service, refusing when the Labels field is hidden on the edit screen. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:labels-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue', 'add', 'remove', 'set' (lists of value keys; add/remove are mutually exclusive with set), 'conflicts', 'sendNotifications'

license-manager.purpose: Determines Structure's effective licence from all sources (Marketplace/UPM licence, a legacy licence key stored in Jira application properties, bundled or app-support data), exposes licensed / writable checks, and allows installing or removing the legacy licence.
contract_notes: Jira application property com.almworks.structure.license (legacy licence) and com.almworks.structure.license.starttime

lifecycle.purpose: Controls the start and stop of all Structure components with the plugin lifecycle: logs a start banner with version, instance id and licence summary, enables cache clearing, subscribes to Jira shutdown, and cleans up leaked thread-locals and template caches on stop.

links-count.purpose: Serves the number of Jira issue links on an issue. The count can be limited to one link type and to inward or outward links. By default it counts all types in both directions.
contract_notes: attribute id: links-count (number); params linkTypeId (0 = all), inward (bool, absent = both)

linksync-config-js.purpose: Form logic for the links synchronizer configuration.

login-page-renderer.purpose: Renders a full Jira-style login page for the external Structure gadget when an anonymous viewer needs to sign in, using Jira login properties and the plugin's gadget login template.

lucene-helper.purpose: Runs Jira issue index searches for Structure: executes JQL or parsed queries (optionally sorted), matches a list of issues against a query in chunks, reads index field values for issue sets, and refuses search when a full reindex is running or the index is inconsistent. Periodically clears Jira's JQL literals cache to limit memory.

macro-resources.purpose: Resources for the external (embeddable) Structure gadget page used in Confluence macros.

mail-sender.purpose: Sends HTML/text emails rendered from the plugin's email templates to Jira users (asynchronously or immediately), adding base URL and the Structure logo; reports whether outgoing mail is configured. Used for sync error/cycle notices and shared perspective notifications.
contract_notes: logo from web resource com.almworks.jira.structure:widget-css img/structure-logo-label.png

main-provider.purpose: Serves core display attributes. 'summary' is the issue summary or the item's name (project, version, label, constant, component, option, group, structure, folder, sprint, Tempo account, request type, generic item, user marked when inactive, Insight object). It also serves 'description' (HTML and text), the extended summary of generators and effectors, and 'url' (browse, profile, Insight and generic item links).

maintenance-manager.purpose: Runs Structure database maintenance (backup, cleanup of orphaned forests, views, perspectives, favourites and properties, removal of old history, sync audit, processes and backups, reindexing) manually or on a daily-time or cron schedule (default 03:00), under a cluster-wide lock, reporting progress through a process.
contract_notes: Admin URL /secure/admin/StructureMaintenance.jspa; form fields scheduled, scheduledHour, scheduledMinute, crontabEnabled, crontabSchedule

maintenanceParamsForm.purpose: Form logic for editing scheduled and manual maintenance parameters.

manage-structure-service.purpose: Backs the 'Manage structures' page data: lists all, favourite and recent structures (rate-limited searching), and enriches them with owner, permissions, last-used time, manual adjustments, synchronizers, effector counts, add-on details, running copy processes and problems.

manage-structures-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for Manage Structures and related pages: structure details and permissions, edit, archive, delete, remove adjustments, views management and copy structure (with copy progress and statistics).

manageAjaxTabs.purpose: Loads Manage Structures tabs and search results via AJAX without full page reloads.

manageSearchType.purpose: Switches the structure search form on Manage Structures between search by structure id and search by parameters.

manageSpa.purpose: Single-page application for Manage Structures: tabbed lists (Recent, Favorite, My, Popular, All, Archived), search, and structure actions including views and synchronizer configuration.

manually-adjusted-provider.purpose: Serves the boolean 'manually-adjusted'. It is true for a row in a generated structure that a user has moved or changed by hand, contrary to what the generators produced. It is based on the forest's generation data.

memo-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets one field of a Structure-native generic item (memo or planning task) to a value, after validating the update with that item's field accessor; no-op if equal. Undo restores the previous value; merged effects record conflicting values.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:memo-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'memo' (memo numeric id or item identity string), 'field' (structure field id), 'value' (field-type serialised value), 'conflicts'

memo-manager.purpose: Public service giving typed access to memo items (lightweight text items placed in structures) by id: read one or many memos and get an update builder for their fields.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as MemoManager

migrateOptions.purpose: Form logic for the Migrate Structure options step.

migration-configuration-manager.purpose: Persists named cloud-migration configurations (scope) chosen by admins: name, status (draft, ready, running, done, failed), selected structure ids, selected extension keys, run time and last editor. Backs the 'Migrate to cloud' admin pages.
contract_notes: AO table MIGRATION_CONFIG (C_NAME, C_STATUS, C_STRUCTURE_IDS, C_EXTENSION_KEYS, C_RUN_AT, C_EDITED_AT, C_EDITED_BY)
Status names DRAFT, READY, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED

migration-configurations-rc.purpose: Page scripts and styles for cloud migration configuration list and editor, including delete dialog and statistics.

multi-group-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes or sets groups in a multi-group-picker custom field; rejects single-group fields. Undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:multi-group-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

multi-labels-custom-field-effect-provide.purpose: Adds, removes or sets labels in a labels-type custom field on an issue; undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:multi-labels-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

multi-select-custom-field-effect-provide.purpose: Adds, removes or sets options of a multi-select or multi-checkbox custom field on an issue; undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:multi-select-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

multi-user-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Adds, removes or sets users in a multi-user-picker custom field on an issue; undo reverses the change.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:multi-user-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

multi-versions-custom-field-effect-provi.purpose: Adds, removes or sets versions in a multi-version custom field of an issue; rejects single-version fields, versions from another project, and changes involving archived versions (except on undo). Undo reverses it.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:multi-versions-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

new-structure-template.purpose: Declares the new structure template extension point: each module appears as a choice in the Create Structure wizard, with title, description, icon and step templates, and configures the newly created structure.
contract_notes: module element name <new-structure-template> usable by this and other plugins
wizard step velocity resources are named by step id; "__end" is the final step

new-structure-wizard-js.purpose: Loaded on all Jira pages; provides the new-structure wizard dialog opened by the 'Create Structure' menu item, with the Empty, Backlog, Agile and Personal Backlog templates.

non-unique-items-provider.purpose: Serves the internal '-non-unique-items' attribute used by distinct (de-duplicating) aggregates: for each subtree it reports which items occur more than once, either as per-item occurrence counts or with each repeated item's value; supports the 'preceding' mode and rejects the 'strict' mode.
contract_notes: internal attribute id '-non-unique-items' (special-cased by the forest value cache)

note-manager.purpose: Stores named Notes columns ('notes') that can be shared across structures: create, rename, archive, list and restore. Each note has a permission scheme (typically bound to a structure) which governs who may create or edit it; names are trimmed, non-blank and at most 190 characters.
contract_notes: AO table NOTE (C_NAME, C_PERMISSION_SCHEME, C_CREATED, C_ARCHIVED)
Note ids exposed as 'dc_note_<n>' and used as item property names
REST /rest/structure/2.0/note (POST create, PUT /{noteId}, PUT /{noteId}/archive, GET /{noteId}, GET /search)

note-searcher.purpose: Searches available notes by name for the note picker, grouping results into the default note, notes already used in the given structure, and other notes, with a result limit.
contract_notes: i18n group labels s.w.notes.note.search.used-notes and s.w.notes.note.search.other-notes

notes-manager.purpose: Stores per-structure, per-item text properties (used for the Notes columns): one value per structure, item and property name, cached and invalidated on change; also lists or deletes all properties of a structure. Changing a value marks the item as changed.
contract_notes: AO table S_ITEM_PROPERTY (C_COMPOSITE_KEY, C_VALUE); composite key format '<structureId>|<typeId>|<longId or |stringId>|<propertyName>'

notes-provider.purpose: Serves per-structure item notes: the 'item property' attribute returns the text stored for an item in the current structure under a property name ('notes' for the Notes column). It is an error when there is no structure and undefined when nothing is stored.
contract_notes: attribute id 'itemProperty' (text); param 'name' (property name, must be valid; Notes column default 'notes')
values come from the structure item property store keyed by (structure id, item, name)

number-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a number custom field on an issue to a given number (or clears it); compares values by the field's stored string form; undo restores the old number.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:number-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

number-sum-provider.purpose: Serves the 'sum' aggregate attribute: for each row, totals a dependent number or duration attribute over the row and its sub-rows. Parameters choose a distinct sum (each item counted once) or a running total over all preceding rows ('preceding'); text-format dependents are summed as numbers.
contract_notes: attribute id 'sum' (formats number/duration/html); params: 'attribute' (nested dependency spec), 'distinct' (boolean)
public-API totals: sum of timespent / timeoriginalestimate / timeestimate with distinct=true
implementing class absent from the decompiled jar; behaviour inferred from callers and the public API

option-source-service.purpose: Provides option lists for pickers when editing planning tasks and similar fields: projects, issue types, priorities, versions, components, sprints, users, groups and custom-field options, with filters (exclude sub-tasks/inactive, can create issues, assignable, project enabled for Structure), grouping and recents.
contract_notes: Option source ids PROJECTS, ISSUE_TYPES, VERSIONS, COMPONENTS, PRIORITIES, SPRINTS, USERS, GROUPS, FIELD_OPTIONS; filter names excludeSubtasks, excludeInactive, checkCreateIssues, checkStructureConfig, checkAssignable, customField, issueTypeId

option-source-tools.purpose: Shared helpers for option pickers: renders the edit HTML of single/multi option pickers from a server template and provides short-lived per-key caches used by the recents and sprint-board suggestion services.

ordering-io.purpose: Stores the manual order of items kept by a manual sorter generator, one record per generator and parent path, as a comma-separated list of serialized item ids.
contract_notes: key format '<generatorId>.<path>', empty list stored as '-'

original-estimate-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Original Estimate (time tracking) to a duration in milliseconds, formatted as a Jira duration, via a validated update; zero counts as empty. Undo restores the old estimate.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:original-estimate-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

original-generator-kind-provider.purpose: For generated rows, tells which kind of generator first produced the row, using the forest's generation history. The value is a one-letter code for extender, grouper, inserter or sorter.

page-rc.purpose: Base styling for server-rendered Structure pages (admin and management pages): theme, page CSS, select styling and images, plus icon fonts and Jira autocomplete.
contract_notes: images served under css/structure/img/ (also referenced by URL)

page-util.purpose: Utilities for server-rendered Structure pages: dynamic option loading, multi-select with ordering, form helpers, URL helpers.

pageCommons.purpose: Shared code for pages that embed the widget (issue, project, Agile): page settings dialog, widget configuration and page decoration.

parent-provider.purpose: Serves 'aggregation-parent': an inner attribute's value taken from an ancestor row. A positive level counts down from the top of the tree. A negative level counts up from the row, so -1 is the parent. The title row can be skipped. Used by the formula parent and ancestor functions.
contract_notes: attribute id 'aggregation-parent' (any); params 'attribute', 'level' (int, legacy alias 'depth'; default -1), 'withoutTitle'

partitioned-cookie-header-filter.purpose: For HTTPS POST requests to the external gadget page (login form) and to the authenticate REST call when s_partitioned=true, adds Secure, SameSite=None and Partitioned attributes to the session cookies set in the response, so logging in inside a third-party iframe (e.g. a Confluence macro) works in browsers with partitioned cookies.
contract_notes: dark feature structure.partitioned.cookies.additional: extra cookie names to treat

perf-audit-log-view-rc.purpose: Dependency bundle (no own files) for the performance audit log admin page: expander, date picker and Structure page utilities.

performance-observer.purpose: Assembles the 'Performance Audit Log' tree from all registered performance-log provider modules, isolating failures; shown on the admin performance audit page and used for support diagnostics.
contract_notes: Admin web action alias PerformanceAuditLogView (template performance-audit-log-view.vm)

permission-scheme-manager.purpose: Parses stored permission scheme specs used by notes: a structure-bound scheme (JSON with structure id; edit follows structure access), basic levels ('none', 'view', ...) and the built-in default-note scheme, and checks a user's permission with readable denial reasons.
contract_notes: Permission scheme spec strings: JSON {"structure":<id>}, lowercase basic level names, 'defaultNote' (stored in NOTE.C_PERMISSION_SCHEME)

permissions-cache.purpose: Short-term cache of computed structure permission levels per user and of global app-permission checks, cleared periodically and on all cluster nodes via a cluster message when permissions change.

permissions-calculator.purpose: Computes a user's access level (none, view, edit, automation, control/admin) to a structure or view from its owner, ordered permission rules (users, groups, project roles, everyone, inheritance from another structure), Jira admin status and global Structure settings, and evaluates global app permissions (use, create structures, synchronization, automation, generators, effectors, global saved columns).

permissionsEditor.purpose: Editor for a structure's permission list on the edit structure page, with user, group and project pickers.

persistent-generator-manager.purpose: Stores persistent generator instances (generator module key, parameters, owning structure) in the database with caching; supports restoring with a given id during backup restore.
contract_notes: AO table GENERATOR (C_ID, C_MODULE_KEY, C_PARAMETERS, C_OWNING_STRUCTURE)

persistent-row-manager.purpose: Stores persistent rows: each row id maps to an item (type, numeric or string id) and semantics. Creates and restores rows, scans rows in bulk with caching, and finds rows for an item through reverse caches.
contract_notes: AO table ROW (ID as row id, C_ITEM_TYPE, C_ITEM_LONG_ID, C_ITEM_STRING_ID, C_SEMANTICS)

personal-backlog-structure.purpose: Wizard template "Personal Backlog Structure": builds a structure with folders/memos for issues assigned to, reported by and watched by the user (JQL inserters grouped by status) and a chosen set of tracking columns saved as a view.

perspective-io.purpose: Stores perspectives (saved snapshots of the Structure page state used for shareable links) with random ids, updates last-used time on read, deletes those unused since a cutoff, counts and restores them.

perspective-mail-sender.purpose: Emails a link to a shared perspective to chosen users with an optional message; if the sender administers the structure and may browse users, it first grants the recipients view permission on that structure.
contract_notes: Mail template id 'shared-perspective'; reads structure id at primary.forestSpec.structureId of the perspective spec

perspective-manager.purpose: Saves and loads perspectives for licensed users who can use Structure, validating the spec, applying saved-column updates to the embedded view specs on load, deleting stale ones for maintenance, and reporting perspective count statistics.
contract_notes: Perspective spec JSON with primary/secondary panels

pinger.purpose: Public utility that periodically calls registered subjects at their requested periods from a single low-priority daemon thread, stopping the thread when idle; used for heartbeat and housekeeping tasks.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as Pinger

planning-task-common.purpose: Shared field editors for planning tasks (labels, date-time, text area, number, option select) loading options and creation fields via REST.

planning-task-manager.purpose: Public service giving typed access to planning-task items (issue-like placeholders that can later become issues) by id: read one or many and get an update builder for their fields.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as PlanningTaskManager

planningTaskCreationDialog.purpose: Dialog to create a new planning task from the Structure Board, validating input and rendering wiki markup.

plugin-manager-helper.purpose: On the Universal Plugin Manager pages, if Structure or a bundled extension app is licensed through a vendor-provided or bundled license (not a Marketplace license), it adds the plugin-manager helper resource that annotates the UPM listing and points to Structure's own license page.

plugin-manager-helper-rc.purpose: Script on the plugin manager: for Structure apps with vendor or bundled licenses, adds a license note linking to Structure's license page, warns when a license certificate is pasted into UPM, and adds an Update button.

plugin-update-checker.purpose: Checks the Atlassian Marketplace for newer versions of an installed app (Structure or its extensions) compatible with the current Jira build, caching the answer; used by the info popup to show 'update available'. Out of scope for the replacement (INVENTORY.md section 5): it never contacts the Marketplace and always reports that no update is known.

portfolio-bridge.purpose: Bridge to Advanced Roadmaps (Portfolio): detects the Portfolio, Roadmaps and Team Management apps, loads shareable and all teams and a team by id, and validates setting an issue's parent with the app's own hierarchy rules, reaching its services reflectively.

portfolio-children-gatherer-factory.purpose: Chooses how to find Advanced Roadmaps parent/child relations: via issue links, the issue index, Jira 11 index, or JQL, automatically by Jira version unless overridden.
contract_notes: dark feature structure.portfolio.childrenGatherer with values auto, links, index, jql, indexJira11

portfolio-integration.purpose: Advanced Roadmaps hierarchy integration: gets children and parent of issues, validates and sets an issue's Roadmaps parent with permission and sub-task checks, recognises team and target start/end custom fields, and exposes teams. Used by the Roadmaps extender and grouper.

portfolio-team-custom-field-effect-provi.purpose: Sets the Advanced Roadmaps (Portfolio) Team field of an issue to a given team or clears it; refused for sub-tasks. Undo restores the previous team.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:portfolio-team-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

primitives-provider.purpose: Serves basic structural attributes for every row: 'count' (number of sub-rows, or only leaves with the 'leaves' parameter), 'depth' and 'level' (nesting depth), 'itemtype' (simplified item type of the row), 'itemid' (item identity as text) and 'issueid' (issue id, issue rows only).

printable-rc.purpose: Styles and script for the printable structure page, including font-size controls.
contract_notes: the printable page also requires web-resource context structure.printable (hook for extension apps)

priority-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Priority to a given priority id via a validated Jira issue update; no-op if already equal; produces an undo effect restoring the old priority.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:priority-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

process-handle-manager.purpose: Public service to create and track long-running processes (e.g. copying, maintenance, effector runs): issues handles for progress reporting, user-visible status and cancellation, with caching; backs the Processes page and process REST.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as ProcessHandleManager

process-io.purpose: Persists long-running process records: status, timestamp, display parameters, managing user, current activity, percent complete and cancellation flag; supports update, delete and bulk deletion of old processes.
contract_notes: AO table PROCESS_STATE (C_TIMESTAMP, C_STATUS, C_PARAMETERS, C_MANAGING_USER, C_ACTIVITY, C_PERCENT_COMPLETE, C_CANCELLED)

progress-provider.purpose: Serves 'progress' for the Progress column: how much of an issue and its sub-tree is done, 0 to 1. It can be based on time tracking, resolution, a percent field, or per-status or per-category percentages. Children can be weighted equally, by time or by a numeric field. The item itself may be included; resolved issues can count as complete.
contract_notes: attribute id: progress (number); internal formats 'progress' (weighted pair) and 'issue-progress-data'

params: basedOn (timetracking|resolution|percentfield|status|category), weightBy (equal|time|field), weightByField, includeSelf, resolvedComplete, percentField, statuses+percents, categories+categoryPercents

project-category-provider.purpose: Serves 'project-category': the name of the project category of an issue's project, or of a planning task's project. It is undefined when the project has no category.

project-parameters-provider.purpose: For project items, serves 'project-lead': the display name of the project lead, as text or as escaped HTML.

project-picker-custom-field-effect-provi.purpose: Sets a project-picker custom field on an issue to a given project (or clears it) via a validated issue update; undo restores the old project.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:project-picker-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
'value' is a project item (item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-project)

project-scope-cache.purpose: Public cache answering which issues belong to projects where Structure is not enabled, using the indexed project of each issue and the plugin's project configuration.

property-service.purpose: Public global key/value store for plugin settings and state (strings, booleans, longs), cached without expiry and cluster-aware.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as PropertyService

query-match-provider.purpose: Serves 'query-match': whether each row matches a query (JQL, Structure's own query language, or text search) run over the current forest. The title row is never matched. The HTML form shows a check-circle icon for matches. An invalid or empty query gives undefined.

query-result-cache.purpose: Short-lived per-user cache (about 60 s) of the set of rows or issues matching a query (JQL, S-JQL, text) within a forest, used by attributes that test query membership.

react-components-common.purpose: Shared React hooks for item-detail field editors (change with loading state).

recent-issue-inserter.purpose: Inserter generator that adds the user's recently viewed issues (Jira issue history, most recent first) and refreshes them about once a minute.
contract_notes: JQL issue in issueHistory() ORDER BY lastViewed DESC

recents-manager.purpose: Remembers each user's recently opened structures (most recent first, capped at 10 by default) in the user's settings, and returns the recent structures the user can still access, including the most recent accessible one used for auto-selecting a structure.
contract_notes: user setting key almworks.jira.structure.recents (space-separated structure ids)

recents-search-service.purpose: Returns, per user and history type, the Jira user-history entries (recently viewed projects, etc.) so pickers can show recent choices first; cached briefly and cleared per user.

reindex-locker.purpose: Protects Structure index searches and synchronization from Jira's full lock-down reindex: waits for the index lock, detects running reindex via events, reports when index use is impossible or the consistency check failed, and retries on closed readers.
contract_notes: dark feature structure.sync.reindex.noLock disables the protection

reindex-manager.purpose: Ensures that a global, locked, managed custom field named 'Structure Index Monitor' exists (creating or recreating it under a cluster lock) so the plugin is notified whenever Jira reindexes an issue.

remaining-estimate-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Remaining Estimate (time tracking) to a duration in milliseconds via a validated update; undo restores the previous estimate.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:remaining-estimate-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

remote-gadget-extension.purpose: Core extension used by the Structure dashboard gadget: when a REST response is assembled it accepts the gadget's requested row windows (forest, row indexes, attributes) and creates attribute value subscriptions for them, returning the subscriptions and a mapping from old to new subscription ids.
contract_notes: extension data key com.almworks.jira.structure:remote-gadget-extension in poll/forest REST responses (fields subscriptions, mapping)

remote-link-objects-provider.purpose: For issues, returns the list of remote (web) links as remote-link items. They are read in bulk from Jira's remote issue link table. A dark feature switches to loading them one issue at a time through Jira's remote link service.
contract_notes: reads Jira entity RemoteIssueLink (column issueid; order globalid, id)

render-helper.purpose: Renders wiki markup to HTML (and to plain text) using Jira's wiki renderer, for content such as help texts and memos.

reporter-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Reporter to a given user via a validated Jira issue update; no-op when same user; undo restores the previous reporter.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:reporter-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

resolution-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Resolution field (by resolution id, or clears it) via a validated Jira issue update; undo restores the previous resolution.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:resolution-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

rest-cfd.purpose: Registers the REST API of the bundled Cumulative Flow Diagram gadget: gadget metadata and validation, feature status, and forecast simulation of a CFD.
contract_notes: /gadget: POST meta, GET validate, GET status

rest-subjects-searcher.purpose: Backs pickers in sharing and configuration dialogs: searches groups, project roles, projects, agile boards and unarchived versions of given projects by text, returning labelled result groups with highlighted matches and footers when results are truncated.

rest-user-builder.purpose: Builds the user representation used in REST responses (key, name, display name, avatar URL, profile link), with special handling for anonymous users and inactive users, and for permission subjects and gadgets.

rest-v1.purpose: Registers the older Structure REST API version 1.0 used by the structure board, gadgets and admin pages: configuration lookups, field configuration, gadget metadata, perspectives (shareable view state), S-JQL troubleshooting, usage statistics, UI configuration, views and widget configuration.
contract_notes: /config: GET projects, types, statuses, transitions, license, licenses, roles, groups, timezone, userPickerPermission, dateFormatStyle
/gadget: GET structures, validate, meta, views, widgetConfigs
/statistics: POST record, PUT enableSending, PUT dismissOffer
/view: GET/POST (root), GET menu, GET default, GET {id}, POST {id}/update, POST {id}/updateSpec, POST {id}/makePublic, POST {id}/makeDefault, GET {id}/associations, DELETE {id}
separate javax (Jira 9-10) and jakarta (Jira 11+) resource sets with the same paths

rest-v2.purpose: Registers the main Structure REST API version 2.0 used by the structure grid and other UIs: structures, forests and updates, polling, attribute values and subscriptions, items, generation control, effects and effector processes, history, notes, saved columns, pickers, configuration and permissions, and miscellaneous helpers.
contract_notes: /structure: GET, POST, GET {id}, GET list, GET/PUT {id}/favorite, PUT recents, GET/PUT {id}/quick-transforms, POST {id}/update, DELETE {id}, GET {id}/description-shown
/forest: POST latest (and GET latest), POST update
/effectorProcess: GET {processId}/status/, POST {processId}/cancel/, cancelAndWait/, resume/, undo/, records/, preview/; POST list/; POST acknowledge
/configuration: GET/PUT projects, POST projects/add, projects/remove; GET/PUT permissions[/{key}], POST permissions/{key}/add, permissions/{key}/remove
/manage-structures: GET one, all, recents, recent-ids, favorites; POST page-details
/note: POST, PUT {noteId}, PUT {noteId}/archive, GET {noteId}, GET search
/saved-column: GET /, GET/POST {columnSource}/{listKey}, PUT/DELETE {columnSource}/{id}, POST {columnSource}/{id}/edit, updateParameters, move/{newListKey}
separate javax (Jira 9-10) and jakarta (Jira 11+) resource sets with the same paths

run-as-user-provider.purpose: For saved generators, serves the user the generator runs as, which is the owner of the structure that holds it. It is undefined for transient generators or when the structure cannot be accessed. Used to show a 'run as' user and its icon.
contract_notes: attribute id: run-as-user (format user); item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-generator

saved-column-io.purpose: Stores saved (reusable) column definitions in the database: name, description, column type, owner (null for global columns) and JSON parameters. Creates, updates, deletes, restores with a fixed id, and promotes user columns to global; caches columns per owner and per id and drops caches on change.
contract_notes: AO table SAVED_COLUMN with columns C_NAME (<=190), C_DESCRIPTION, C_TYPE, C_OWNER (user key, <=190, null = global), C_PARAMETERS (JSON)
owner group key '*' denotes global columns in caches

saved-column-manager.purpose: Registry of saved-column sources (the bundled read-only source and the user-stored source), looked up by source id. When a view specification is loaded, it replaces each column that references a saved column with that column's current type and parameters, removes columns whose saved column no longer exists, and strips the reference from locally modified copies the user cannot read.
contract_notes: view column parameter 'savedColumn' holds the reference in the form '[modified/]<sourceId>/<columnId>'
source ids 'stored' and the bundled source id

saved-structure-filters-log-provider.purpose: Adds a section listing every saved Jira filter whose JQL uses the structure() function (id, name, query) to the performance audit log.

scheduled-job-manager.purpose: Public service that runs registered periodic jobs: about once a minute it checks each job, takes a cluster lock, decides if it should run and executes it on the system job pool, recording the last run time in plugin properties. Jobs can be added, removed or forced to run.
contract_notes: Last-run times stored in plugin properties under 'sjm.<jobKey>'
Public API component exported as ScheduledJobManager

script-runner-single-issue-picker-effect.purpose: Sets a Script Runner single issue-picker custom field to a given issue (or clears it). Rejects fields that are not single issue pickers or that Script Runner reports as read-only; undo restores the previous linked issue.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:script-runner-single-issue-picker-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

scriptrunner-integration.purpose: Optional bridge to ScriptRunner Behaviours: for an issue, determines which fields Behaviours mark read-only so Structure's inline editing honours them. Works through reflection against different ScriptRunner versions and fails soft.
contract_notes: Detects plugin key com.onresolve.jira.groovy.groovyrunner and its Spring bean behaviourManagerImpl

sd-integration-supplier.purpose: Supplies a shared bridge to Jira Service Management: reads and changes the customer request type of issues (with validation that target and source belong to the same service desk and compatible issue type), resolves portals and request types for display.
contract_notes: Detects plugin key com.atlassian.servicedesk and custom field type com.atlassian.servicedesk:vp-origin

security-filter.purpose: Runs before login on the external (embeddable) Structure gadget page. It intercepts the Content-Security-Policy header Jira sets and replaces it with a policy computed by a shared security helper that is aware of application links, so the page can be framed by linked applications such as Confluence.
contract_notes: URL pattern /secure/StructureExternalGadget.jspa, dispatchers REQUEST/INCLUDE/FORWARD/ERROR, location before-login

sequence-provider.purpose: Serves 'seq', the hierarchical outline number of each row (1, 1.1, 1.2.3 ...), worked out down the tree. Generators, effectors, loop markers and rows with special semantics get no number and do not use one up.

servlet-bridges.purpose: Adapts servlet request/response/session objects of either servlet API generation (javax for Jira 9-10, jakarta for Jira 11+) to a common form used by plugin code.
contract_notes: declared twice with Jira version restrictions [9.0.0,11.0.0) and [11.0.0,)

simple-calendar-provider.purpose: Built-in calendar provider offering two calendars: a default round-the-clock calendar (id 0) and a work calendar (id 1) of weekdays 9:00-17:00, used by duration calculations in formulas.

single-group-custom-field-effect-provide.purpose: Sets a single group-picker custom field on an issue to a given group or clears it; rejects multi-group fields. Undo restores the previous group.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:single-group-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

single-select-custom-field-effect-provid.purpose: Sets a single-select (or radio) custom field on an issue to a given option or clears it, via a validated issue update; undo restores the previous option.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:single-select-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

single-user-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a single user-picker custom field on an issue to a given user or clears it, via a validated issue update; undo restores the previous user.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:single-user-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

single-version-custom-field-effect-provi.purpose: Sets a single version-picker custom field to a version or clears it. Refuses versions from another project and adding/removing archived versions (except when undoing). Undo restores the previous version.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:single-version-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Extra parameter 'isUndo' (boolean); 'value' is a version item (item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-version)

sjql-troubleshooting.purpose: Script for the Structured JQL troubleshooting admin page: runs a check and shows logs via REST.

slf-favorite-structures-factory.purpose: Lazily builds the 'Favorite Structures' menu links from the user's favorites, up to half of Jira's dropdown limit (at least four). If there are more, it adds a 'more' link to the favorites view of Manage Structures.

slf-structure-configs-factory.purpose: Lazily builds the 'Recent Structures' menu links: the user's recently viewed structures first, then other viewable structures ordered by popularity, up to half of Jira's dropdown limit (at least four). Each link opens the board for that structure, with the name shortened to 40 characters.

sorter-agile-rank.purpose: Sorter "Agile Rank": sorts issues by a Jira Software rank field; moving issues up or down in the structure changes their rank.

sorter-attribute.purpose: Sorter "Attribute": sorts sibling rows by an attribute or field value (ascending/descending, locale-aware text), keeping items without a value last; manual reordering within sorted rows is blocked.

sorter-manual.purpose: Sorter "Manual Reordering": remembers the order in which users manually arranged items under each parent (or group path) of generated content and reapplies it on regeneration.
contract_notes: orderings stored in AO table ORDERING keyed by generator id and parent path

spic-sum-up-integration.purpose: Compatibility support for the 'Epic Sum Up' app: recognises its time custom field (converting seconds to formatted durations for the current user) and lists its progress/indicator custom field types that can only be rendered client-side.
contract_notes: Third-party custom field type keys aptis.plugins.epicSumUp:epic-sum-up-custom-field-time and the -attachment-indicator, -comments-indicator, -issue-count-progress, -progress, -status-category-progress, -story-points-progress, -type-allocation, -time-progress variants

sprint-effect-provider.purpose: Moves an issue into, out of, or between Jira Software sprints. Requires the Agile integration and sprint field, rank permission, non-closed source and target sprints, and optionally that both sprints share a board. Merged effects record conflicting sprints; undo moves the issue back.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:sprint-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

sprint-parameters-provider.purpose: For sprint items, serves 'sprint-start' and 'sprint-end' as times (time-zone aware), formatted text or HTML. It also serves 'sprint-goal' as text, and gives the description of sprint rows as HTML and text.

sprint-tracker.purpose: Listens to issue updates; when the Sprint field of an issue changes, it reports a synthetic 'sprint updated' change for each of that issue's sub-tasks so structures and attributes depending on inherited sprint refresh.
contract_notes: Sprint field names configurable via structure.sprint.field.names (default 'Sprint')

stacktrace.js.purpose: Bundled stack-trace library used by the front-end utilities for error reporting.

stagil-integration.purpose: Detects custom fields of type 'STAGIL Assets relation' (cached per field) so Structure can treat them specially.

stateful-manager.purpose: Keeps short-lived server-side state objects (for multi-step operations such as backup, restore, copy and migration wizards) under numeric ids. Each state belongs to the user who created it; only that user or a Jira admin may read, touch or remove it. States idle for 6 hours are expired by a background job every 30 minutes.
contract_notes: in-memory only; state ids are a per-node increasing sequence

statistics-manager.purpose: Collects anonymous usage statistics: components record counts and active users asynchronously; pending values are flushed to the database every 10 minutes. A daily job purges old data and, if the admin opted in, posts the aggregated report to the vendor's app-support endpoint. Also decides whether to show the 'enable statistics' offer and remembers dismissals. Out of scope for the replacement (INVENTORY.md section 5): the upload to the vendor. Collecting, storing, purging and the opt-in offer stay in scope; opting in records the setting and sends nothing.
contract_notes: Exported service implementing the public statistics recorder interface
plugin property statistics.sendingEnabled; scheduled job id / property statistics.lastSentTime
statistic names userCount, activeUser.<feature>, dayCount, pluginVersion.<x.y[.z]>, structureCount, archivedCount, perspectiveCount, etc.

stats-offer.purpose: Banner script asking a system administrator to enable anonymous usage statistics; accepting or dismissing calls the statistics REST endpoints and shows a thank-you note.

stats-offer-decorator.purpose: On the admin summary, admin pages and Structure admin pages, when the viewer is a Jira system administrator who should still be offered usage statistics sending, adds the statistics-offer banner resource asking them to enable anonymous statistics.

status-attributes-provider.purpose: For rows whose item is a Jira status, serves the extended summary as Jira's standard status lozenge HTML. It renders through Jira's issue-status template and returns an error when rendering fails.
contract_notes: attribute id 'extended-summary' (html) for item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-status

status-category-provider.purpose: Serves 'status-category': the category of an issue's current status. It is given as the category id (number or order), its name (text), or a coloured lozenge (HTML). It is an error when the issue has no status or category.

status-effect-provider.purpose: Moves an issue to a target status by finding and executing a workflow transition from its current status (optionally only transitions without a screen, optionally setting a resolution), with or without notifications. Errors if no suitable transition exists; undo transitions back and restores the resolution.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:status-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

statusup-config-js.purpose: Form logic for the status rollup synchronizer configuration, loading projects, types, statuses and transitions.

stored-column-source.purpose: The 'stored' saved-column source: exposes two lists, 'global' (shared) and 'user' (personal, hidden for anonymous users). Enforces that users only read and edit their own personal columns, that global columns are managed only by users holding the manage-global-saved-columns permission, and that columns may move to global but never back; supports backup export (owner) and restore.

structure-activity-provider.purpose: Activity Streams provider "Structure": publishes structure change history (items added, copied, moved, removed) to Jira activity streams, with filter options for structure, ancestor item and synchronizer.
contract_notes: filter option keys: structure, ancestor, synchronizer

structure-admin.purpose: Top-level 'Structure' section in the Jira administration navigation, visible to Jira administrators; it contains the main, extensions and other-actions subsections.

structure-admin-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the administration pages: backup, restore, migrate preview, configuration, defaults, license details, maintenance, project settings, setup guide, support, help editor, audit logs and troubleshooting.

structure-admin-extensions.purpose: Empty subsection of the Structure admin section where Structure extension apps can add their own admin links.
contract_notes: location structure-admin, weight 200; other plugins target section structure-admin/structure-admin-extensions

structure-admin-main.purpose: 'Structure Administration' subsection of the Structure admin section: configuration, defaults, attributes, backup, restore, migrate, maintenance, license, support and help links.
contract_notes: location structure-admin, weight 100; items use section structure-admin/structure-admin-main

structure-admin-other.purpose: 'Other actions' subsection of the Structure admin section, holding the Setup Guide and the Migrate to Cloud links.

structure-anonymize-handler.purpose: Participates in Jira user anonymization and ownership transfer for structures: lists and removes permission rules that name the user, lists and deletes the user's private (unshared) structures, and lists and transfers ownership of the user's shared structures to another user, reporting failures per structure.
contract_notes: links shown in Jira's anonymization UI: StructureBoard.jspa?s=<id>

structure-async-request-handler.purpose: Runs expensive REST requests (poll, forest, item, value, effect and synchronizer calls) as background jobs bound to a configurable timeout, so a client can retry and pick up the same job's result instead of blocking.

structure-attribute-loader-provider.purpose: Declares the attribute loader provider extension point: modules contribute loaders that compute attribute values (fields, aggregates, formulas) for rows shown in structure columns, exports and queries.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-attribute-loader-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-aui.purpose: Structure's styling adjustments for Atlassian UI components and its select-box wrapper.

structure-available-on-issue-page-checke.purpose: Answers whether Structure should appear on the issue page, controlled by a feature flag; drives the issue-page web resources condition.

structure-available-to-user-checker.purpose: Answers whether the current user may see Structure UI: the app must have a license and Structure must be enabled for the user; drives the issue-page decorator condition.

structure-backup-provider.purpose: Declares an extension point through which add-ons participate in Structure backup, restore and migration, writing and reading their own data for the selected structures.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-backup-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-board-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the Structure Board page, the printable export page (header/data row HTML, warnings, depths), the search-data page, the cache-clearing page and the keyboard shortcuts page.

structure-cache-helper.purpose: Clears Structure's caches, either all caches or those of one user, locally or on all cluster nodes by broadcasting a message.

structure-calendar-provider.purpose: Declares the calendar provider extension point: modules list work calendars (by numeric id and name) that formulas and duration calculations can use.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-calendar-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-components.purpose: Single public entry point exported to other plugins that hands out the main Structure services (structure, row, forest, attribute, generator, folder, view, favorite, sync, job, backup, effector, property and query services).

structure-configuration.purpose: Holds the app's global and per-user configuration: which projects Structure is enabled for, app permissions (use, create structure, synchronization, automation, configure generators/effectors, execute effectors, manage global saved columns) as 'anyone' flags or subject lists, default structure globally and per project, issue/project page UI defaults and per-user overrides, and attribute sensitivity settings.
contract_notes: Jira application properties prefixed com.almworks.jira.structure.config.: enabledForAllProjects, enabledProjects, enabledForAnyone, enabledSubjects, createForAnyone, creatorSubjects, synchronizationForAnyone, synchronizationSubjects, automationForAnyone, automationSubjects, defaultStructure, defaultStructurePP, issuePage.autoSwitch, projectPage.autoSwitch, issuePage.autoCollapse, issuePage.keepWhileNavigating, attributeSensitivity
same issuePage/projectPage keys stored in user preferences for per-user UI settings

structure-core-extension.purpose: Declares a generic internal extension point through which add-ons can contribute configuration to the structure widget and attach extra data to structure REST responses (poll, forest, item, effect).
contract_notes: module element name <structure-core-extension> usable by this and other plugins
extension data is keyed in REST responses by the full module key, e.g. com.almworks.jira.structure:remote-gadget-extension

structure-database-provider.purpose: Provides the plugin's direct database access (connections, SQL with resolved table names) on top of Active Objects for the Structure plugin key.
contract_notes: plugin key com.almworks.jira.structure; AO namespace com.almworks.jira.structure

structure-datetime-formatter.purpose: Provides date and date-time formatting for attribute values in either the viewing user's or the system time zone and locale, plus helpers that shift date-only field values between time zones so dates display on the correct day.

structure-deleted-event-listener.purpose: When a structure is deleted, removes its synchronizers, manual adjustments, structure properties and item properties (notes).

structure-effect-provider.purpose: Declares the effect provider extension point: modules know how to describe, apply and undo a specific kind of Jira change (field value, status, comment, conversion) that generators and effectors request.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-effect-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-effector.purpose: Declares the effector extension point: effectors compute a set of Jira changes (effects) from structure contents and attribute values that users can preview and apply, with a configuration form and summary template.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-effector> usable by this and other plugins

structure-effectors-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the effector edit dialog and forms, effector process start/progress/preview/result pages, the effector audit page and the processes list.

structure-event-bridge.purpose: Translates non-issue Jira and third-party events into item changes: versions, projects, components, issue types, priorities, archived issues, permissions, agile sprints and boards, Tempo, Insight/Assets objects and Xray test runs; custom field changes clear all caches.
contract_notes: listens by class name to com.atlassian.greenhopper.* sprint and board events, com.tempoplugin.* events, com.riadalabs...InsightObjectUpdatedEvent, com.xpandit.raven.event.TestRunStatusUpdatedEvent

structure-export-renderer-provider.purpose: Declares the export renderer provider extension point: modules supply renderers that turn column values into cells when a structure is exported to Excel or printed.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-export-renderer-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-extender.purpose: Declares the extender generator extension point: modules add child items under existing items (e.g. sub-tasks, linked issues) at configured levels when the forest is generated.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-extender> usable by this and other plugins

structure-features-statistic-source.purpose: Contributes feature-usage counters to the statistics report by scanning all structures (as system): number of automated structures and generators by module key (with field or attribute detail for some), effector instances, folders, memos by icon, planning tasks, and synchronizers per module and enabled state.
contract_notes: statistic names: automatedStructureCount, generatorCount[.<module>[.<field|attr>]], effectors.structures, effectors.instances.total/unresolved/byModuleKey:<key>, folderCount, memoCount[.<icon>], planningTaskCount, synchronizedStructureCount, syncCount[.<module>], syncCount.enabled[.<module>]

structure-field-manager.purpose: Provides the catalogue of Jira fields that Structure can read and write uniformly: a fixed set of system fields (summary, description, assignee, due date, estimates, time spent, environment, reporter, priority, issue type, project, labels, versions, components) plus supported custom fields, with localized names and renderer info; refreshed every minute. Used by planning tasks, memos, groupers and effectors.
contract_notes: system field ids: summary, description, assignee, duedate, timeoriginalestimate, timeestimate, timespent, environment, reporter, priority, issuetype, project, labels, versions, fixVersions, components

structure-field-type-manager.purpose: Defines the field value types Structure supports (user, multi-user, group, date, date-time, text, multi-line text, number, duration, project, issue type, priority, version(s), components, labels, sprint, single/multi option) with storage conversion, HTML view and edit rendering and validation, and maps Jira custom field type keys to them.
contract_notes: supported custom field type keys: com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.customfieldtypes:userpicker, datepicker, textfield, textarea, project, version, float, datetime, labels, multiversion, multiuserpicker, grouppicker, multigrouppicker, select, multiselect; com.pyxis.greenhopper.jira:gh-sprint

structure-filter.purpose: Declares the filter generator extension point: modules hide rows in the generated forest that do not satisfy a condition.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-filter> usable by this and other plugins

structure-gadget.purpose: Jira dashboard gadget 'Structure' that shows a chosen structure (or a filter/query) in a compact structure widget, with selectable view, number of rows, custom title, optional edits and separate maximized-view settings. Loads the gadget resources plus the structure.widget context so extension apps can add their parts.
contract_notes: user prefs stored by Jira dashboards: structureId, viewId, filterId, customTitle, numRows, isConfigured, allowChanges, useCanvasSettings, canvas-viewId, canvas-numRows, filterType, filterQuery

structure-general-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for all pages: shared action helpers (static resource prefix, admin check, self link, user and permission formatting, resource requiring), structure and user info objects, field info and rendering helpers.

structure-generators-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the generator edit dialog and the generator forms (sub-task types, supported fields, Agile rank fields and boards, link types and directions).

structure-grouper.purpose: Declares the grouper generator extension point: modules insert group rows and place items under the group matching a computed value, optionally changing item data when rows are moved between groups.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-grouper> usable by this and other plugins

structure-helper-panel.purpose: Hidden data panel in the right column of the Jira issue view. It emits the issue id/key and flags (show Structure section, issue not in the initially selected structure, auto-collapse, navigation hint used, show time tracking) that the issue-page script reads to build the Structure section and Structure time-tracking.
contract_notes: element id s-helper-panel-content with data-show-structure, data-issue-id, data-issue-key, data-unstructured, data-auto-collapsed, data-used-navigation-hint, data-show-timetracking

structure-info.purpose: The Structure info dialog: version and app license info, help, feedback and support sections, links to plugin manager, welcome page and cache clearing.

structure-info-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds a 'Structures' section to the performance audit log listing every structure with its owner, its synchronizers (module, parameters, user, enabled state), generator and effector rows with parameters and ancestor rows, and manual-adjustment status.

structure-inserter.purpose: Declares the inserter generator extension point: modules add a list of items at the generator position when a structure is built; each has a label, dialog title, icon, configuration form and summary template.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-inserter> usable by this and other plugins
generator module key persisted in generator records as "<plugin key>:<module key>"

structure-integration-details-provider.purpose: Declares an extension point for companion add-ons to report a product icon and which structures they integrate with, so Structure can show integration markers on its structure lists.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-integration-details-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-issue-index.purpose: Maintains a database index of which issues occur in which structures (with occurrence counts), updated incrementally when structure content changes and rebuilt per structure on reindex; answers 'is issue X in structure Y' and 'which structures contain issue X' using a cache keyed by issue.
contract_notes: AO table ISSUE_INDEX with columns C_ISSUE_ID, C_STRUCTURE_ID, C_OCCURRENCES

structure-item-type.purpose: Declares the item type extension point: each module defines a kind of item that can be placed in structure rows (issues, folders, memos, Jira objects, etc.), how it is resolved, displayed, checked for visibility, created or edited.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-item-type> usable by this and other plugins
item type id stored in data = "<plugin key>:<module key>", e.g. com.almworks.jira.structure:type-issue

structure-manager.purpose: Central store of structures and their forests: creates, copies (with or without forest), restores, archives and deletes structures; enforces permission levels (view, edit, admin) and generator/effector configuration rights; persists forests and forest change logs, records history, keeps the issue index current, publishes structure-deleted events, and periodically trims stored forest changes.
contract_notes: AO tables STRUCTURE, FOREST, FOREST_CHANGE (and related STRUCTURE_PROPERTY)
dark features structure.manager.cache.timeout, structure.manager.allbeans.cache.timeout, structure.forest.cache.timeout, structure.aobsm-ufs.cache.timeout

structure-misc-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for remaining pages: issue-page time tracking section, external gadget and its login page, cloud migration configurations, structure field options, project tab links, background process status and workflow checker forms.

structure-ownership-transfer-handler.purpose: Plugs into Jira's user anonymization/ownership transfer: lists and transfers ownership of structures, views and synchronizers owned by a user to another user.

structure-performance-log-provider.purpose: Declares the performance log provider extension point: modules contribute named sections of diagnostic performance information shown in the plugin's performance/troubleshooting output.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-performance-log-provider> usable by this and other plugins

structure-permissions.purpose: Editor used on the admin page that sets which users, groups or roles may use Structure and create structures (application permissions).

structure-projectnav-css.purpose: Icon styles for the Structure project-sidebar entry and Agile tab, loaded on project, admin and Agile board pages.
contract_notes: contexts: jira.browse.project, jira.admin, gh-rapid, gh-rapid-plan, gh-rapid-work

structure-property-service.purpose: Public per-structure key/value store (keys up to 170 characters) used for structure-level settings such as quick transformations, description visibility, manual adjustments flag and last-used time; supports bulk reads across structures.
contract_notes: Known keys quick-transforms, showDescription, manualAdjustments.enable, lastPolledMillis

structure-query-builder-factory.purpose: Public factory for building S-JQL structure queries programmatically.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as StructureQueryBuilderFactory

structure-query-constraint.purpose: Declares the S-JQL constraint extension point: each module registers a named constraint function (attribute fname) that can be used inside S-JQL queries to match rows.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-query-constraint> usable by this and other plugins

structure-query-constraint-registry.purpose: Maintains the lookup of S-JQL constraint names from all enabled S-JQL constraint modules, rebuilt when the module set changes and warning on name conflicts.

structure-query-parser.purpose: Public parser turning S-JQL text into executable structure queries over a forest, using registered constraints.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as StructureQueryParser

structure-query-skeleton-factory.purpose: Declares an extension point that lets add-ons turn a typed search query (e.g. a Confluence CQL query) into an initial forest skeleton for an ad-hoc search structure; JQL and text query types are handled internally by built-in inserters.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-query-skeleton-factory> usable by this and other plugins
query types "jql" and "text" map to inserter-jql / inserter-text (recent: inserter-recent-issues); "cql" maps to com.almworks.structure.pages:inserter-confluence-pages

structure-resource-service.purpose: Backs the structure REST resource: get one structure, list structures for a user (default/project/recent ordering, anchor issue), search, favourite toggling, mark as recent, quick transformations per structure, description visibility, and create/update/delete structures including owner change.
contract_notes: REST /rest/structure/2.0/structure (GET /{id}, GET /list, GET search, GET|PUT /{id}/favorite, PUT /recents, GET|PUT /{id}/quick-transforms, POST create, POST /{id}/update, DELETE /{id}, GET /{id}/description-shown)

structure-row-manager.purpose: Public row service unifying persistent and transient rows: resolves rows by id, scans many rows, creates rows, finds all rows for an item, and builds row mappers that trace generated rows back to their originals.
contract_notes: Public API component exported as RowManager

structure-sorter.purpose: Declares the sorter generator extension point: modules reorder sibling rows by a value, optionally turning manual reordering into data changes (such as rank).
contract_notes: module element name <structure-sorter> usable by this and other plugins
optional second icon with key "desc" for descending order

structure-sync-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for synchronizer pages: list, create, edit, resync, import/export and the synchronizer-specific forms (links, Agile, status rollup, sub-tasks).

structure-synchronizer.purpose: Declares the synchronizer extension point: modules of this kind (with label, description, rules text, order and a configuration form template) become selectable synchronizers that can be installed on a structure to keep it in sync with Jira data.
contract_notes: module element name <structure-synchronizer> usable by this and other plugins
separate descriptor implementations for Jira 9 and Jira 10+

structure-usage-tracker.purpose: Records when each structure was last used (polled), throttled to at most one write per structure every two hours, so 'Manage structures' can show last-used dates.

structure-user-anonymization-handler.purpose: Plugs into Jira's user anonymization: lists and deletes a user's Structure personal data, i.e. private structures and views they own, their permission rules and favorite marks.

structure-user-key-change-handler.purpose: Plugs into Jira's user anonymization: when a user key changes, updates the user key stored in Structure history, statistics, effector processes and synchronizer records.

structure-users-event-bridge.purpose: Reacts to user, group membership, project role, permission scheme, issue security scheme, user preference/profile/avatar and anonymization events by clearing permission and per-user caches (cluster-wide) and recording user or group changes.

structure-views-js.purpose: Script for the structure Views page: choose which views appear in a structure's view menu (public and shared views, default or customized settings), with ordering.

structure-welcome-allowlist.purpose: Allows Jira's restricted Velocity engine to call the listed read-only getters from Structure's templates for the welcome page and the help dialog: images, help title/content/contacts, licensing state and which companion apps are installed.

structure-workflow-condition.purpose: Workflow condition "Issue Matches Structure Query" (disabled by default): allows a transition only if the issue, in the default or a chosen structure, matches an S-JQL query evaluated as the project lead or a chosen user; issues not in the structure pass only if allowed.
contract_notes: CLASS:com.almworks.jira.structure.workflow.StructureWorkflowChecker stored in workflow XML as class.name
args: runAsLead, runAsUserKey, runAsUserName, structureType (default|manual|containing-deprecated), structureId, queryString, allowUnstructured

structure-workflow-validator.purpose: Workflow validator "Issue Matches Structure Query": blocks a transition with an explanatory message unless the issue matches an S-JQL query in the default or a chosen structure, evaluated as the project lead or a chosen user.
contract_notes: CLASS:com.almworks.jira.structure.workflow.StructureWorkflowChecker stored in workflow XML as class.name
args: runAsLead, runAsUserKey, runAsUserName, structureType, structureId, queryString, queryDesc (custom failure text), allowUnstructured

structuremodule.purpose: Placeholder 'Structure' module in the left column of the Jira issue view. Its own content is empty; the issue-page script replaces it with a structure widget showing structures that contain the issue (with recent, favorite and default structure choices). Displayed when Structure is enabled for issue pages and the user has access to non-archived structures.

sub-task-issue-cache.purpose: Public cache answering which issues are sub-tasks, based on the indexed issue type.

subtasks-provider.purpose: Serves 'subtasks': the list of an issue's sub-task issues, computed in bulk from Jira's sub-task link.

suggested-sprint-boards-service.purpose: For a project and user, returns the agile boards relevant to that project, used to suggest sprints in pickers; cached briefly.

summary-effect-provider.purpose: Sets an issue's Summary via a validated Jira issue update; no-op if unchanged; undo restores the previous summary.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:summary-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'issue' (issue id), 'sendNotifications' (boolean), 'conflicts' (list of competing values set when several effects for one issue are merged)

sync-audit-log.purpose: Records an audit trail of synchronizer actions: each sync run writes a description record plus action records grouped together, buffered and written to the database every 30 seconds; supports querying by synchronizer, structure and time range (capped) and deleting records older than a date. Shown in the admin support pages.
contract_notes: AO table SYNC_AUDIT_RECORD with columns C_SYNC_INSTANCE, C_SYNC_MODULE_KEY, C_STRUCTURE_ID, C_TIMESTAMP, C_GROUP_ID, C_DATA (JSON)

sync-audit-log-view-rc.purpose: Script and styles for the synchronization audit log admin page: date-range filtering, expandable entries and undo of synchronizer actions.

sync-events-manager.purpose: Event queue feeding synchronizers: records Jira changes, structure history entries, resync requests and autosync-enable notices, and hands them to the sync manager in batches. On a single node it keeps events in memory; on Data Center it shares them through the database across nodes, optionally postponing while issues are being reindexed.
contract_notes: AO table SYNC_EVENT with columns C_TYPE, C_DATA, C_TIMESTAMP, C_SYNC_INSTANCE (Data Center mode)

sync-filter.purpose: Synchronizer that adds issues matching a saved filter or JQL query to the structure (add mode) and/or removes issues that stop matching (remove mode); it reacts to issue changes incrementally and checks all issues on resync.
contract_notes: synchronizer module key com.almworks.jira.structure:sync-filter stored with sync instances
params include filterId, jql, add, remove, addRootIssue, removeOnlyFromUnderAddRootIssue, moveFromUnderAnotherRoot, subtasks

sync-gh.purpose: Agile synchronizer: keeps Jira Software Rank and Epic membership in sync with positions in the structure for selected projects or an Agile board; repositioning rows changes rank/epic and changes in Jira reposition rows.
contract_notes: params include viewId, projects, rankField, syncRank, syncEpics, independentRanking, subtasks

sync-hide-helper.purpose: Decides whether synchronizer features are shown in the UI: true if the synchronizers feature flag is on or at least one synchronizer is installed (checked once).

sync-links.purpose: Synchronizer that keeps the parent-child hierarchy of a structure in sync with Jira issue links of a chosen link type and direction, in either or both directions (links or structure as source of truth), creating or deleting links and moving rows accordingly.
contract_notes: params include linkTypeId, childIsLinkSource, primacy (links|structure|none), orphanAction (remove|moveUp), parentFilterId/parentJql, childFilterId/childJql, expandParent, expandChild, useAllLinks

sync-manager.purpose: Manages synchronizer instances attached to structures: install, update, uninstall, enable/disable autosync, full and one-time resync (as background processes), ownership transfer. Listens to issue and structure changes and runs incremental synchronization roughly every 2 seconds with throttling, sending email on sync errors; stores definitions in the database.
contract_notes: AO table SYNC_INSTANCE with columns C_STRUCTURE_ID, C_MODULE_KEY, C_OWNER, C_PARAMETERS, C_ENABLED
dark features structure.sync.autosync.interval, structure.sync.mindelay, structure.sync.maxdelay, structure.sync.autosync.maxJiraChanges, structure.sync.presync.event.pull.disabled

sync-observer.purpose: Keeps a bounded in-memory log of recent synchronizer runs with timings and reports which synchronizers are installed and enabled per structure, for the performance audit log.

sync-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds a 'Syncs' section to the performance audit log with recent synchronizer runs (duration, start time, details) as recorded by the sync observer.

sync-status-rollup.purpose: Synchronizer that transitions a parent issue to the earliest (in a configured order) status among its direct sub-issues in the structure, limited to selected projects, issue types and workflow transitions, optionally setting a resolution.
contract_notes: params include applicableProjects, applicableTypes, states (statusId, allowedTransitions, actionId, workflowName), resolutionId

sync-subtasks.purpose: Synchronizer that places Jira sub-tasks under their parent issues when the parent is already in the structure, moving misplaced sub-tasks back; changes in the structure are not written back to Jira.

sync-tools-factory.purpose: Provides cluster-aware caches (expiring and non-expiring, via Jira's cache manager), node-local caches and cluster locks to all plugin components.
contract_notes: cache and lock names created by other components (e.g. structure, forest, view, favorites, savedColumnGroups)

template-agile.purpose: Wizard step UI and images for the Agile structure template.

template-backlog.purpose: Wizard step UI and images for the Backlog structure template.

template-common.purpose: Shared wizard dialog code and styles for new-structure templates.

template-personal-backlog.purpose: Wizard step UI and images for the Personal Backlog structure template.

tempo-integration.purpose: Integration with Tempo apps (Accounts, Teams, Timesheets, Planner): detects availability, reads an issue's account, teams and roles, searches accounts/teams/roles, totals worked and planned seconds, validates and sets accounts, and interprets Tempo events, reaching Tempo services reflectively.
contract_notes: plugin keys com.tempoplugin.tempo-accounts, com.tempoplugin.tempo-teams, is.origo.jira.tempo-plugin, com.tempoplugin.tempo-plan-core

tempo-internal-issues-interceptor.purpose: Watches PUT requests to Tempo's internal issue REST endpoints (which modify issues without normal Jira events). It resolves the issue key from the URL and, after the request completes, reports an issue-updated change to Structure's change tracking so attributes and generated content refresh.

tempo-provider.purpose: When the Tempo apps are installed, serves two duration attributes.
