'tempo-worklogged' is time logged in Tempo Timesheets in a date range, filtered by accounts, users, teams and billable. 'tempo-timeplanned' is time planned in Tempo Planner, filtered by users, teams and roles. Values are loaded in bulk and recalculated when Tempo access or worklog-view permissions change.

text-custom-field-effect-provider.purpose: Sets a text (single- or multi-line) custom field on an issue to a given string via a validated issue update; empty and missing are equal; undo restores the old text.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:text-custom-field-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)

time-in-status-provider.purpose: Serves 'timeinstatus': how long an issue has spent in chosen statuses or status categories, worked out from status history. Options can count only time after a reopen, only stays ending in target statuses, or only the current status, and can use a working calendar. A stay still in progress counts up to now. Available as duration, number or HTML.
contract_notes: attribute id 'timeinstatus' (duration/number/html); params 'statuses' and 'targetStatuses' (values 'status:<name>' or 'category:<id or key>'), 'targetEnabled', 'reopen', 'useCurrentStatus', 'calendar' (calendar full id)

transient-generator-manager.purpose: Keeps short-lived generator instances (for example those created for query or transformation views) in memory, assigning them ids distinguishable from persistent ones.

transient-row-manager.purpose: Keeps in memory the temporary rows created by generators (each tied to its creator and original row), with compact item encoding and per-creator indexes; rows are cleaned when creators drop them.

transition-date-provider.purpose: Serves 'transition-date': when an issue first or (by default) last entered a given status, by id or name, or any status of a category. It also serves 'field-change-list': an issue's history of values for a field, as value-and-time entries starting from creation.
contract_notes: attribute id 'transition-date' (time); params 'status' (id or name) or 'category' (new/indeterminate/done/undefined and aliases such as 'todo', 'in progress', 'complete'), 'transition' ('first' | 'latest')

treefield-integration.purpose: Integration with the third-party Tree custom field app: when installed, extracts the display name of a tree field value.
contract_notes: plugin key ru.slie.jira.tree-customfield; field type keys ru.slie.jira.tree-customfield:tree-single-customfield, :tree-multi-customfield

type-attachment.purpose: Item type for issue attachments, visible with Browse Projects on the issue; exposes created, file size, file name and author.
contract_notes: formula fields: created, filesize, filename, author

type-cf-option.purpose: Item type for custom field options (by option id); exposes value, disabled flag, parent option and sequence; displays cascading text for child options.
contract_notes: formula fields: value, isdisabled, parent, sequence

type-change-history-group.purpose: Item type for an issue change history group (one change event), exposing author, time, the changed issue and its change items to formulas.
contract_notes: formula fields: author, time/timeperformed/timestamp, item/changeditem/issue/changedissue, changes/changeitems

type-change-history-item.purpose: Item type for a single field change inside an issue change history group, exposing field, from/to values and texts, the group and whether it is incremental.
contract_notes: formula fields: field, from, fromtext, to, totext, changegroup, incremental

type-comment.purpose: Item type for issue comments, visible with Browse Projects on the issue; exposes author, update author, created, updated and body.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-comment (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: author, updateauthor, created, updated, body

type-effector.purpose: Item type for effector rows placed in a structure; new effector instances are created from a module key and parameters and are copied per owning structure.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-effector (persisted in rows/items)

type-folder.purpose: Item type for folders: named containers created from the grid, renamed by users with edit permission on the owning structure, and copied when used in another structure; named folders can also be virtual (string id) as group headers.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-folder (persisted in rows/items)

type-generator.purpose: Item type for generator rows (inserters, extenders, groupers, sorters, filters); new generators are created from a module key and parameters, and copying a structure gives it its own generator copies.

type-group.purpose: Item type for Jira user groups (by group name); always visible; exposes the group name.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-group (persisted in rows/items)

type-insight-object.purpose: Item type for Insight/Assets objects, visible according to Insight permissions; exposes the object label and other fields to formulas.

type-issue.purpose: Item type for Jira issues: resolves issues by id, applies Browse Projects permission, supports creating new issues and editing issues from the structure grid (fields, transitions), detects deleted issues and exposes issue fields to formulas.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-issue (persisted in rows/items)

type-issue-link.purpose: Item type for issue links, visible when the user can see both linked issues; exposes source, destination, sequence and link type.
contract_notes: formula fields: source, destination, sequence, type

type-issue-link-type.purpose: Item type for issue link types, always visible; exposes name, inward/outward descriptions, style and sub-task/system flags.
contract_notes: formula fields: name, inward, outward, style, issubtask, issystem

type-issuetype.purpose: Item type for Jira issue types (string id), always visible; exposes name, description, sequence and whether it is a sub-task type.

type-label.purpose: Item type for an issue label (string id, validated as a label of at most 255 characters); always visible; displays the label text.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-label (persisted in rows/items)

type-loop-marker.purpose: Item type for the marker row inserted when generation would create a cycle; it refers to the row where the loop was detected and becomes dead when that row no longer exists.

type-memo.purpose: Generic item type "Memo": structure-owned text notes created and edited in the grid, with optional color and icon, shown with a memo icon; values come from the generic item store and are exposed to formulas.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-memo (persisted in rows/items)

type-memo-change-history-group.purpose: Item type for a change history record of a memo (generic item), exposing author, time, the changed memo and change items to formulas.
contract_notes: formula fields: author, time, item/memo, changes/changeitems

type-missing.purpose: Item type used for rows whose item can no longer be resolved; always treated as inaccessible and dead.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-missing (persisted in rows/items)

type-planning-task.purpose: Generic item type "Planning task": structure-owned placeholder tasks with issue-like fields that can be created from a sample issue or task and later converted to real issues; visibility also honours per-field configuration.
contract_notes: create parameter sampleItemId (issue or planning task id)

type-priority.purpose: Item type for Jira priorities (string id), always visible; ordered so that higher priorities sort first unless a dark feature reverses it.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-priority (persisted in rows/items)

type-project.purpose: Item type for Jira projects (by id), visible to users who can browse the project; exposes name, key, url, email, lead and description to formulas.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-project (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: name, key, url, email, lead, description

type-project-component.purpose: Item type for project components (by id), visible with Browse Projects on the component's project; exposes name, description and lead.

type-remote-link.purpose: Item type for remote issue links, visible when the user can see the issue; exposes source issue, title, url, application and status details.
contract_notes: formula fields include source, issue, title, url, apptype, appname, icon and status fields

type-resolution.purpose: Item type for Jira resolutions (string id), always visible; exposes name, description and sequence.

type-sd-request-type.purpose: Item type for Jira Service Management customer request types, visible when Service Management is available and the user can load the request type; exposes name, issue type, description and help text.
contract_notes: formula fields: name, issuetype, description, helptext

type-sprint.purpose: Item type for Jira Software sprints (by sprint id), visible when the user can see the sprint; exposes name, dates, state, sequence, goal and board.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-sprint (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: name, startdate, enddate, completedate, state, sequence, goal, originboardid/rapidviewid

type-status.purpose: Item type for Jira statuses (string id), always visible; exposes name, description, sequence and category; ordered by sequence.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-status (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: name, description, sequence, category

type-structure.purpose: Item type for a whole structure placed as an item (e.g. in lists of structures); resolved by structure id and visible only to users with view permission on that structure.

type-tempo-account.purpose: Item type for Tempo accounts (by numeric account id), used by the Tempo account grouper; always visible.

type-user.purpose: Item type for Jira users (by user key); always visible; exposes key, name, active flag, email and display name to formulas.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-user (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: key, name, isactive, emailaddress, displayname

type-version.purpose: Item type for project versions (by id), visible with Browse Projects on the version's project; exposes project, name, description, archived/released flags, release and start dates; ordered by version sequence.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-version (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: project, name, description, isarchived, isreleased, releasedate, startdate

type-version-name.purpose: Item type representing a version name shared across projects (string id), used by the version-name grouper; always visible.

type-worklog.purpose: Item type for issue work log entries, visible with Browse Projects on the issue; exposes author, dates, comment, start date and time spent.
contract_notes: item type id com.almworks.jira.structure:type-worklog (persisted in rows/items)
formula fields: author, updateauthor, created, updated, comment, startdate, timespent

ui-configurator.purpose: Decides what the Structure panel shows when opened on the board, issue or project page: applies the user's UI settings and auto-switch strategy, resolves the default structure (skipping archived ones), and picks the initial structure: the only viewable one, an explicitly requested one, the one remembered from navigation for the same issue, then the strategy's choice.
contract_notes: navigation hint value is a '|'-separated string whose first part is the structure id and third part the issue key

uikit.purpose: Bundled UI kit, i18n and styling libraries and a React content renderer used by newer Structure components.

upgrade.001.purpose: First plugin upgrade task ('upgrade prepare'); performs no data changes itself, but when the JVM system property for reset is set it clears the stored build number so all upgrade tasks re-run.

user-display-name-searcher.purpose: Finds Jira users by exact display name across user directories, with a short-lived bounded cache; used by formula functions that resolve user names.

user-field-renderer.purpose: Renders a user as an HTML snippet (profile link, avatar, display name) for user-type attribute values in the grid.

user-icon-cache.purpose: Short-lived cache of interactive HTML avatars for users (small avatar with user hover card markup), falling back to the anonymous avatar, used in the grid UI.

user-printable-icon-cache.purpose: Same as the user avatar cache but renders plain image tags (name and display name as alt/title) suitable for printable and exported output.

user-property-provider.purpose: Serves 'user-property': a Jira user property, returned as text, for the user named by another attribute that holds a user key. The property is stored under 'jira.meta.' plus the given property name. A dark feature can turn this off.
contract_notes: attribute id 'user-property' (text); params 'userKey' (nested attribute spec yielding a user key), 'propertyName'

value-cache-cleaner.purpose: Background worker that periodically evicts old generations of cached attribute values when the cache grows too large, reporting removed and retained counts to performance statistics.

value-path-provider.purpose: Serves the internal attribute 'aggregation-value-path'. It links each row's value of an inner attribute to its parent row's value, so that parent and ancestor lookups can walk up the tree. It can include the invisible super-root and can skip the title row.

value-text-converter.purpose: Converts arbitrary issue field values (including values from third-party custom fields such as Advanced Roadmaps team and Tree custom field) into display text, joining multiple values with commas; used for text attributes, grouping, export and field information.

various-query-parser.purpose: Parses a query of type 'sjql', 'jql' or 'text' (quick text search) into something that can be validated and executed against a forest, returning matching rows; JQL/text match the issues among the forest rows.
contract_notes: Query type names sjql, jql, text

velocity-request-context-factory-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter for getting, setting, caching and clearing Jira's Velocity request context (base URL info) for rendering outside normal requests.

vendors.purpose: Shared third-party library bundle for the newer front-end single-page applications.

version-info-performance-log-provider.purpose: Adds a 'Jira instance information' section to the Structure performance audit log: Structure version, Jira version, Data Center node id (or cluster off) and the current time.

version-name-provider.purpose: Supports 'version name' rows, which group versions that share a name across projects. It finds the issues under such a row and their projects, then derives the row's summary (the version name), icon (released or archived state, or 'mixed') and combined description from the matching versions.
contract_notes: serves summary, icon and description, each with param aggregate=true

version-parameters-provider.purpose: For version items, serves 'version-start' and 'version-release' as times (optionally adjusted for time zone), formatted text or HTML. It also serves 'version-description' as text, and gives the plain-text description of version rows.

view-anonymize-handler.purpose: Participates in Jira user anonymization and ownership transfer for views: deletes the user's private views and transfers ownership of the user's shared views to another user, reporting failures per view.

view-manager.purpose: Public view service; on first use (cluster-locked) creates the default views 'Issue Details', 'Basic view', 'Planning', 'Tracking', 'Triage', 'Entry' and 'Gadget View', reusing same-named existing ones, and sets them as the global default view settings per page; otherwise delegates to the stored view manager.

visibility-observer.purpose: Observes when the structure container inside a gadget or macro becomes visible.

warning-effect-provider.purpose: Represents a warning instead of a change: always resolves to an error carrying a translated message (i18n key plus arguments) and the related items, so automation can report problems in the effect preview/log. Duplicate warnings are merged.
contract_notes: Stored-effect module key 'com.almworks.jira.structure:warning-effect-provider' (persisted in stored effects / undo records and built by the public API core effects helper)
Parameters: 'i18nKey', 'arguments' (list), 'affectedItems' (list of item identity strings); default message key s.ext.effect.unknown-error

webresource-manager-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter to require web resources and contexts on the current page, read required resources and put page metadata.

webresource-url-provider-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter that builds static URLs for plugin resources and the static resource prefix (relative or absolute).

welcome.purpose: Welcome page scripts and styles: carousel, lightbox, slider, use cases and search dropdown.

wf-statistics.purpose: Contributes workflow usage statistics: scans active Jira workflows for Structure's workflow condition and validator and counts their configurations (structure type default/manual/containing, JQL in the query, unstructured allowed or blocked, run as project lead or user).
contract_notes: workflow function args read: class.name, structureType (containing|default|manual), allowUnstructured, runAsLead, queryString

wi-admin-project-structure.purpose: Project settings link 'Structure' opening the per-project Structure settings page (whether the project is enabled and its default structure).

wi-attributes.purpose: Admin link 'Attributes' opening the attribute sensitivity settings page. System administrators only.

wi-backup-link.purpose: Admin link 'Backup Structure' opening the page that creates a backup file of all Structure data. System administrators only.

wi-default-project-structure.purpose: Menu link to the current project's default structure, labelled with the abbreviated structure name and the project key. Shown only when that structure is viewable and differs from the system default.

wi-default-system-structure.purpose: Menu link to the system-wide default structure, labelled with its abbreviated name and its description as tooltip. Shown when that structure is viewable.

wi-help-link.purpose: Admin link 'Help Tool' opening the page where administrators edit the custom help content and contacts shown to users on the welcome page and help dialog. Shown when the welcome feature is enabled.

wi-license-link.purpose: Admin link 'License Details' opening the page to view and update the Structure license. Jira administrators.

wi-maintenance-link.purpose: Admin link 'Maintenance' opening the page to schedule or run Structure maintenance. System administrators only.

wi-migrate-link.purpose: Admin link 'Migrate Structure' opening the page for partial restore from a backup or migration of structures from another Jira. System administrators only.

wi-migrate-to-cloud-link.purpose: Admin link 'Migrate Structure to Cloud' opening the list of cloud migration configurations used with the Jira Cloud Migration Assistant. System administrators only.

wi-processes.purpose: Menu link 'Manage Effectors' opening the page that lists the user's effector processes.

wi-projectnav-structure.purpose: Adds a 'Structure' entry to the project sidebar navigation. It opens the project page with the Structure panel selected, shown only when the user may use Structure and the project is enabled for Structure.

wi-restore-link.purpose: Admin link 'Restore Structure' opening the page for a complete restore of Structure data from a backup. System administrators only.

wi-structure-admin.purpose: Admin link 'Configuration' opening the general Structure configuration page (enabled projects, who may use or create structures, etc.). Jira administrators.

wi-structure-create-wiz.purpose: Menu link 'Create Structure'. Its style class makes the front end open the new-structure wizard dialog in place; without scripts it goes to the create-structure page. Shown only to users allowed to create structures.

wi-structure-defaults.purpose: Admin link 'Defaults' opening the page for default structure and default user-interface settings. Jira administrators.

wi-structure-jira-home-51.purpose: Adds 'Structure' as a choice in the user menu's 'My Jira Home' options, making the Structure Board the user's Jira home page. Shown to users who may use Structure.
contract_notes: Jira stores the chosen home as the complete web-item key com.almworks.jira.structure:wi-structure-jira-home-51 in user preferences

wi-structure-link.purpose: The 'Structure' entry in Jira's top navigation bar, opening the Structure Board. It is also the dropdown that holds the welcome, recent, favorite, default, query, management and effector sections. Shown to users allowed to use Structure.
contract_notes: link /secure/StructureBoard.jspa, linkId wi-structure-link (used by shortcut 'g s')

wi-structure-manage.purpose: Menu link 'Manage Structures' opening the structure management page on its 'recent' tab.

wi-structure-query.purpose: Menu link 'Query' that opens the Structure Board in query mode with an empty JQL search, so issues can be searched and shown in the board.

wi-structure-setup-guide.purpose: Admin link 'Setup Guide' opening the Structure setup guide page (initial configuration checklist). Jira administrators only.

wi-support-link.purpose: Admin link 'Support' opening the Structure support tools page. System administrators only.

wi-welcome-to-structure.purpose: Menu link 'Welcome to Structure' that opens the Structure welcome page.

widget.purpose: Umbrella resource that loads the full structure widget with all Atlassian and local dependencies; required by every page showing a structure.

widget-atlas-deps.purpose: Groups the Jira/AUI front-end resources the widget needs (dialogs, select, inline dialog, toggles, field editors, calendar, JQL autocomplete, keyboard commands).

widget-bare.purpose: The structure widget itself (the main front-end bundle: grid, panels, toolbar, editing, columns), without the Atlassian and library dependencies so it can be embedded elsewhere.

widget-css.purpose: All stylesheets and images of the structure widget (board, toolbar, footer, panels, banners, inputs, grid). Its image folder is also used for links in e-mails.
contract_notes: image folder img/ (e.g. structure-logo-label.png) referenced by URL from e-mails

widget-i18n.purpose: Front-end message bundle: a generated script that the i18n transformer fills with Structure's localized UI texts for the user's locale.

widget-i18n-transformer.purpose: Web-resource transformer applied to the front-end message bundle: when the script is served it fills it with Structure's localized UI texts for the requesting user's locale, so client code can look up translated strings. Separate implementations for Jira 9, 10 and 11.
contract_notes: transformer key widget-i18n-transformer, applied to extension js of web-resource widget-i18n (i18n/structure_messages.js)

widget-i18n-transformer-cache.purpose: Generates and caches per-locale script bundles of UI message texts for the front end (registering them with the client resource registry), with ETags; cleared with other caches.
contract_notes: generated script registers messages under window.almworks.util.resources(...)

widget-i18n-transformer-common.purpose: Version-independent core of the web-resource transformer that turns i18n placeholder resources (i18n/<name>_messages.js) into localized script message bundles: adds the user's locale to the resource URL and serves the matching message keys by prefix.
contract_notes: URL query params 'locale' and 'i18n.prefixes'; resource name pattern i18n/*_messages.js
default prefixes include sw., s.w., st.widget., s.g., s.generic., s.cfd., st.search., s.iv., s.gantt, s.effector, s.tempo, s.wp. and others

widget-local-deps.purpose: Groups Structure's own widget dependencies: fonts, jQuery UI, utilities, effector styles, favorites, i18n, the bare widget and the theme observer.

wiki-editor-theme-observer.purpose: Keeps rich-text editor content in sync with Jira's light/dark colour mode.

wiki-rendering-provider.purpose: Serves 'wiki-render': another attribute's text rendered to HTML with Jira's wiki-markup renderer. Formula columns use it for their wiki display format.

worklog-objects-provider.purpose: Serves 'worklogs': the list of work-log items on an issue that the current user may see. Visibility is checked in bulk against role and group restrictions, and the work logs are pre-loaded for formulas.
contract_notes: attribute id: worklogs (format value); item type com.almworks.jira.structure:type-worklog; reads Jira table Worklog (id, issue, rolelevel, grouplevel)

worklogged-provider.purpose: Serves 'worklogged': the total time logged on an issue within a period. The period is a named preset relative to now, or an explicit from/to range in a given time zone. Work logs can optionally be limited to one author, one group or one project role.
contract_notes: params: period, dateFrom, dateTo, timeZone, author (user key), group, role; at most one of author/group/role

wp-projectnav-structure.purpose: Content of the project sidebar 'Structure' page: a Structure Board widget scoped to the current project (project key, id and a project scope name passed as hidden fields), with a toolbar and issue action links. Loads the widget resources and the project-page script; shows an error message if one is set.
contract_notes: template templates/structure/structureboard/pcv-structure-tabpanel.vm; hidden inputs st-pcv-scope-jql, st-pcv-scope-name, st-pcv-project-key, st-pcv-project-id

wr-project-page.purpose: Script for the project sidebar Structure page: wires the project-scoped structure widget, its page settings dialog and link to the project's Structure settings.

wr-setup-guide.purpose: Script for the Setup Guide admin page; lets the admin enable usage statistics sending from the guide.

ws-admin-project-structure.purpose: Section added to a project's administration (project settings) sidebar to hold the Structure project settings link.

ws-default-structures.purpose: 'Default Structure' section of the Structure top menu. Shown when the system-wide default structure, or the default structure of the current project, is viewable by the user.

ws-favorite-structures.purpose: 'Favorite Structures' section of the Structure top menu. Shown only when the user has favorite structures; filled by the favorites link factory.

ws-processes-section.purpose: Section of the Structure top menu holding the effector processes link.

ws-structure-configs.purpose: 'Recent Structures' section of the Structure top menu. Shown when the user can see at least one non-archived structure; filled by the recent-structures link factory.

ws-structure-manage-section.purpose: Section of the Structure top menu holding 'Create Structure' and 'Manage Structures'.

ws-structure-query-section.purpose: Section of the Structure top menu that holds the 'Query' link.

ws-welcome-to-structure.purpose: Section of the Structure top menu that holds the 'Welcome to Structure' link. Shown unless the welcome feature has been switched off by a dark feature.

ww-structure.purpose: Registers all Structure server-rendered pages and dialogs: the Structure Board, printable view, issue-page time tracking, create/edit/copy/archive/delete structures and views, synchronizer and effector dialogs and processes, all admin pages (configuration, defaults, backup/restore/migrate, maintenance, license, support, audit logs, troubleshooting, cloud migration, help), welcome page and the embeddable external gadget.
contract_notes: Webwork aliases (/secure/<alias>.jspa, admin ones also under /secure/admin/): StructureBoard, StructureTimeTrackingSection, StructureAdmin (commands editProjects, setProjects, editAppPermission, setAppPermission, view), StructureDefaults, StructureBackup, StructureRestore, StructureMigrate, ViewStructureShortcuts, ManageStructure, EditStructure, CreateStructure, StructureViews, DeleteStructure, StructureArchive, StructureSearchData

Aliases cont.: StructureSync, StructureResync, StructureProcessStatus, StructureSyncEnable, StructureSyncEdit, StructureSyncDelete, StructureMaintenance, StructureLicenseDetails, StructureDarkFeatures, StructureSupport, StructuredJqlTroubleshooting, SyncAuditLogView, PerformanceAuditLogView, StructureAttributeTroubleshooting, StructureImport, StructureExport, StructureCopy, StructureRemoveAdjustments, StructurePrintable, StructureBulkChange

Aliases cont.: StructureProjectSettings, StructureSetupGuide, StructureAOSupport, StructureGeneratorEdit, StructureEffectorProcess, StructureEffectorEdit, StructureAttributeSensitivity, ClearStructureCaches, StructureEffectorAudit, StructureProcesses, StructureMigrationConfigurations (commands list, create, edit, view, save, publish, delete, draft), StructureHelp (commands view, edit, clear, cancel, savePreview, showPreview, save), StructureWelcome, StructureHelpDialog, StructureExternalGadget
Common view results: disabled -> templates/structure/disabled.vm, securitybreach -> /secure/views/securitybreach.jsp

xml-datatype-converter-bridge.purpose: Version-specific adapter to print and parse ISO/XML date-time strings.
